generic.Defined scope/population: All QA defects logged for the current review cycle that still show status Unassigned in the GRC platform.
generic.In-scope period: The closed QA review cycle whose scored defects are being assigned for correction.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assigned Underwriter, severity and due date populated on every defect record in the cycle.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of assigned corrective actions equals the cycle defect count in the QA defect log.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scored QA worksheet and file screenshot attached to each action with the assignment timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Defects that cannot be assigned recorded with the reason and the audit manager disposition.
generic.Test population: Every corrective action record raised for the review cycle in the GRC platform.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero defects remain with a blank Assigned Underwriter or a blank due date.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed or unassignable defects routed to the Underwriting Quality / Audit Manager for decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assignment register lists defect ID, assignee, severity and due date for every cycle defect.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform corrective action records plus the assignment register in the QA SharePoint library.

steps.title: Filter the cycle defect log in the GRC platform
sop: Open the QA defect log in the GRC platform and filter to the current review cycle.
Apply status = Unassigned and export the list so the starting population is fixed.
Done when the unassigned defect population for the cycle is listed and counted.
verify: Compare the unassigned count against the total defects logged for the cycle.
Pass when the exported list accounts for every cycle defect still awaiting assignment.

steps.title: Identify the binding underwriter per defect in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open each defect policy number in the underwriting workstation and read the bind transaction user.
Record the underwriter who bound the file, never the assistant who keyed the transaction.
Done when every defect carries a confirmed binding underwriter name.
verify: Spot check five defects against the bind transaction history in the workstation.
Pass when the recorded name matches the binding underwriter on each checked policy.

steps.title: Set Assigned Underwriter on each defect record in the GRC platform
sop: Update the Assigned Underwriter field on each unassigned defect from the confirmed list.
Save each record and confirm the status moves from Unassigned to Assigned.
Done when no defect in the cycle still shows a blank Assigned Underwriter.
verify: Re-run the Unassigned filter on the cycle defect log.
Pass when the Unassigned filter returns zero records for the cycle.

steps.title: Apply severity-driven due dates in the GRC platform
sop: Set Critical defects to 5 business days, Major to 15 business days and Minor to next renewal.
Calculate dates from the assignment date and enter them on each corrective action.
Done when every assigned defect carries a due date matching its severity rule.
verify: Sample one defect of each severity and recompute the due date from the assignment date.
Pass when each sampled due date matches the severity rule with no blank dates in the cycle.

steps.title: Attach the QA worksheet and file screenshot to each corrective action
sop: Pull the scored QA worksheet and the file screenshot from the QA SharePoint cycle folder.
Attach both to the matching corrective action record before notification is sent.
Done when every corrective action carries its scored worksheet and screenshot.
verify: Open a sample of corrective actions and confirm both attachments open and match the policy.
Pass when no sampled action is missing its worksheet or screenshot evidence.

steps.title: Issue assignment notifications and confirm acknowledgement
sop: Send the assignment notification from the GRC platform to each assigned underwriter.
Monitor the acknowledgement flag and chase any record still unacknowledged after 3 days.
Done when every assigned defect shows a green acknowledgement flag or a logged chase.
verify: Review the acknowledgement column across the cycle assignment register.
Pass when all assignments are acknowledged or carry a recorded chase and escalation.

steps.title: Publish the assignment register for manager review
sop: Export the assignment register showing defect ID, assignee, severity and due date.
Review the register for correct assignee and proportionate due dates and note any change.
Done when the reviewed register is filed to the QA SharePoint cycle folder.
verify: Check the filed register against the GRC defect log for the same cycle.
Pass when register rows reconcile to the GRC corrective actions with no blank fields.

generic.Defined scope/population: Three to five blind calibration files spanning one clean, one borderline and one clearly defective file.
generic.In-scope period: The calibration round preceding the next QA review cycle scoring window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every reviewer score sheet complete for all four rubric criteria with no blank score cells.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reviewer score sheet count equals the number of reviewers multiplied by calibration files.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calibration minutes and the reissued QA rubric stored with the new rubric version number.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Criteria left unresolved after debate logged with the interim interpretation and owner.
generic.Test population: All rubric criteria scored across the calibration files by every participating reviewer.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No criterion left with an inter-reviewer variance greater than one point.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved scoring disputes escalated to the Underwriting Quality / Audit Manager for ruling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Minutes record attendees, files reviewed and the agreed interpretation per criterion.
generic.Evidence location: Calibration minutes and rubric version in the QA SharePoint library with scores in Excel.

steps.title: Select the blind calibration files from the QA defect log
sop: Pick 3 to 5 files spanning one clean, one borderline and one clearly defective outcome.
Anonymise underwriter and prior scoring so reviewers score blind.
Done when the anonymised calibration set is loaded to the QA SharePoint folder.
verify: Check each selected file for an outcome mix and removed identifying detail.
Pass when the set covers clean, borderline and defective files with no visible prior score.

steps.title: Issue the QA scoring worksheet to each reviewer in Excel
sop: Distribute the current QA scoring worksheet to each reviewer with the calibration file list.
State the deadline and that scoring must be completed before any discussion.
Done when every reviewer holds the worksheet and the scoring deadline.
verify: Confirm each named reviewer received the worksheet and calibration set.
Pass when no reviewer is missing the worksheet or the file access.

steps.title: Collect independent reviewer scores in Excel
sop: Collect each completed worksheet and consolidate scores into one comparison workbook.
Reject any worksheet with blank criteria and request completion before the session.
Done when every reviewer score is captured for every calibration file.
verify: Count returned worksheets against reviewers multiplied by calibration files.
Pass when the consolidated workbook has no blank score cells.

steps.title: Quantify score spread per criterion in Excel
sop: Compute the maximum spread per criterion across rate adequacy, form selection, authority and documentation.
Flag every criterion where the spread exceeds one point.
Done when the spread table lists each criterion with its flagged status.
verify: Recompute two flagged spreads by hand from the raw scores.
Pass when the spread table reproduces the raw score differences exactly.

steps.title: Debate flagged criteria and agree interpretations
sop: Work through every flagged criterion with the reviewers and surface the reasoning behind outliers.
Agree the interpretation to apply and record it against the criterion in the minutes.
Done when every flagged criterion has an agreed written interpretation.
verify: Re-score the flagged criteria against the agreed interpretation.
Pass when re-scored spread on every criterion is one point or less.

steps.title: Sense check interpretations against live underwriting practice
sop: Test each agreed interpretation against how the guideline is actually applied at bind.
Raise any interpretation that would score compliant underwriting as defective.
Done when every agreed interpretation is confirmed workable or amended.
verify: Review the challenged interpretations and their amendments in the minutes.
Pass when no agreed interpretation conflicts with the current underwriting guideline.

steps.title: Publish the scoring guidance note and reset the rubric version
sop: Update the QA rubric with the agreed interpretations and increment the version number.
Publish the guidance note and minutes to the QA SharePoint library and the GRC platform.
Done when the new rubric version and minutes are published to reviewers.
verify: Open the published rubric and confirm the version number and interpretations.
Pass when the live rubric version matches the version cited in the calibration minutes.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every QA finding in the closed review cycle and each underwriter who owns one or more findings.
generic.In-scope period: The closed QA review cycle being fed back before the next cycle opens.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Communication date and underwriter response captured against every finding in the log.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Findings communicated equals findings logged for the cycle in the GRC platform.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Per-underwriter findings extract and session notes stored with the extract date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Disputed findings logged and routed to the audit manager with the adjudication outcome.
generic.Test population: All cycle findings and all underwriters carrying findings in the review cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No finding without a communication date and no underwriter without a logged session.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputes adjudicated by the Underwriting Quality / Audit Manager before cycle finalisation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each finding shows communication date, underwriter response and any training flag.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform finding records with session notes filed in the QA SharePoint cycle folder.

steps.title: Generate the per-underwriter findings extract from the GRC platform
sop: Filter the QA defect log to the closed review cycle and group findings by underwriter.
Export one findings extract per underwriter with policy number and failed criterion.
Done when every underwriter with cycle findings has an extract.
verify: Sum the extract rows and compare against the cycle finding total.
Pass when extract rows reconcile to the cycle findings with no omitted underwriter.

steps.title: Schedule one-to-one feedback sessions in Microsoft 365
sop: Book a session with each underwriter holding findings before the cycle close date.
Attach the underwriter extract to the invite so they can prepare.
Done when every affected underwriter has a booked session.
verify: Compare the booked session list against the underwriter extract list.
Pass when no underwriter with findings is missing a booked session.

steps.title: Walk the findings with each underwriter
sop: Open each cited policy in the underwriting workstation during the session.
Explain the scored criterion that failed and the evidence behind the finding.
Done when every finding for that underwriter has been walked and discussed.
verify: Check the session note lists each policy number discussed.
Pass when every finding on the extract appears in the session note.

steps.title: Record the underwriter response against each finding
sop: State accept or dispute for each finding and give the reason where disputed.
Confirm the response wording captured in the GRC platform is accurate.
Done when each finding carries a recorded accept or dispute response.
verify: Filter the cycle findings for blank response values.
Pass when no finding in the cycle has a blank underwriter response.

steps.title: Route disputed findings for adjudication in the GRC platform
sop: Flag every disputed finding and assign it to the Underwriting Quality / Audit Manager.
Attach the underwriter reason and the original evidence to the dispute record.
Done when every dispute is routed with its evidence before cycle finalisation.
verify: List open disputes against the cycle close date.
Pass when no dispute remains unadjudicated at cycle finalisation.

steps.title: Adjudicate disputed findings
sop: Review each disputed finding against the rubric and the file evidence.
Uphold, amend or withdraw the finding and record the ruling with the reason.
Done when every dispute carries a recorded adjudication outcome.
verify: Check each adjudicated finding shows an outcome and a rationale.
Pass when no disputed finding is closed without a documented ruling.

steps.title: Flag training-need findings for the competency gap feed
sop: Tag findings that reflect a knowledge gap rather than a one-off slip in the GRC platform.
Export the tagged set to the competency gap assessment input file in SharePoint.
Done when the tagged training-need set is exported for gap assessment.
verify: Compare the tagged set against the cycle findings by defect category.
Pass when every knowledge-gap category finding carries the training flag.

generic.Defined scope/population: Bound and declined files across every line of business, excluding cancellations flat, in the review period.
generic.In-scope period: The forward QA year the sampling methodology will govern.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Random rate, selection seed, targeted overlays and rubric weightings all stated in the methodology.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documented minimum sample equals at least 5 percent of monthly bound files per underwriter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved methodology stored with version number, approval date and approver name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lines granted a lower sample rate recorded with the rationale and approval.
generic.Test population: The methodology document sections covering population, random rate, overlays and rubric.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Approved methodology carries a version number, approval date and named approver.
generic.Exception handling path: Deviations from the standard rate approved by the Underwriting Director / Manager before use.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Random rate plus targeted overlay rules documented for every line of business.
generic.Evidence location: QA methodology library in SharePoint with the control reference held in the GRC platform.

steps.title: Define the sampling population in the methodology document
sop: State the population as bound and declined files in the period excluding cancellations flat.
Name the source system fields that identify the population in the extract.
Done when the population definition and its source fields are written.
verify: Test the definition against a prior period extract in Excel.
Pass when the definition reproduces the expected bound and declined counts.

steps.title: Set the random sample rate and selection method
sop: Set a minimum monthly random rate of 5 percent of bound files per underwriter.
Document the seed or query used so any draw can be reproduced.
Done when the random rate and reproducible selection method are documented.
verify: Re-run the documented draw method on a test population.
Pass when the same seed reproduces an identical sample list.

steps.title: Define the targeted overlay rules
sop: Define overlays for new underwriters, above-authority files, new products and prior-defect repeaters.
State the trigger condition and the extra file count for each overlay.
Done when every overlay has a written trigger and volume.
verify: Check each overlay trigger maps to an available data field.
Pass when every overlay can be executed from the policy system extract.

steps.title: Document the scoring rubric criteria and weightings
sop: Record the rubric criteria and weightings referenced by the sampling plan in Excel.
Confirm the rubric version cited matches the live rubric in the GRC platform.
Done when the rubric criteria and weightings are stated with a version reference.
verify: Compare the cited rubric version to the published rubric.
Pass when the methodology cites the current published rubric version.

steps.title: Confirm coverage across every line of business
sop: List every line of business and map the random rate and overlays applying to each.
Record any line granted a different rate with the rationale.
Done when no line of business is left without a stated sampling rule.
verify: Cross-check the line list against the product catalogue.
Pass when every active line has a documented random rate and overlay rule.

steps.title: Obtain sign-off from the Underwriting Director / Manager
sop: Review the methodology for population, rate, overlays and rubric consistency.
Record approval with name and date on the document front sheet.
Done when the approval name and date are recorded on the methodology.
verify: Open the approved document and read the approval block.
Pass when the front sheet shows approver name, approval date and version.

steps.title: Publish the approved methodology to the QA library
sop: Store the approved methodology in SharePoint with its version number in the file name.
Withdraw the superseded version so only the current methodology is retrievable.
Done when only the approved current version is published.
verify: Search the QA library for prior methodology versions.
Pass when only the approved current version is visible to reviewers.

generic.Defined scope/population: QA and audit defects in the cycle that breach the systemic escalation trigger for underwriting quality.
generic.In-scope period: The completed QA cycle plus the prior cycles used to prove recurrence.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Escalation record carries root cause, quantified exposure, management owner and target date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Policies affected and premium at risk reconcile to the underlying defect and policy extract.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation record and supporting analysis retained with the cycle date and dashboard version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Issues meeting the trigger but not escalated logged with the reason and manager decision.
generic.Test population: All defect clusters tested against the escalation trigger for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Trigger breach confirmed at 3 or more underwriters or a defect rate above the QA threshold.
generic.Exception handling path: Trigger disputes decided by the Underwriting Director / Manager before the committee pack closes.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Escalation shows root cause, exposure, named owner and a target remediation date.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform escalation record with the exposure analysis in Power BI and SharePoint.

steps.title: Test the issue against the escalation trigger in Power BI
sop: Check whether the defect repeats across 3 or more underwriters in the cycle.
Check whether the defect rate exceeds the QA threshold for the cycle.
Done when the trigger test result is recorded for the issue.
verify: Recount affected underwriters from the defect log behind the dashboard.
Pass when the dashboard trigger result matches the underlying defect log.

steps.title: Write the root cause statement
sop: Separate guideline gap, system control gap and underwriter capability as candidate causes.
State which cause the evidence supports and cite the defect records behind it.
Done when a single evidenced root cause statement is written.
verify: Test the statement against the cited defect records.
Pass when the cited defects support the stated cause and rule out the others.

steps.title: Quantify the exposure from the policy population
sop: Count the policies affected and total the premium at risk for the defect pattern.
Identify any rating or form error requiring policy remediation.
Done when policies affected, premium at risk and remediation need are quantified.
verify: Reconcile the affected policy count to the source policy extract.
Pass when quantified exposure ties back to the underlying policy records.

steps.title: Raise the escalation record in the GRC platform
sop: Create the escalation tagged to the underwriting quality risk in the GRC platform.
Enter root cause, exposure, management owner and target date.
Done when the escalation record is saved with all required fields populated.
verify: Open the saved record and check each mandatory field.
Pass when no mandatory escalation field is blank.

steps.title: Confirm the management owner accepts the escalation
sop: Review the root cause and exposure and accept or challenge the assignment.
Confirm the target date is achievable and record any agreed change.
Done when the named owner has accepted the escalation and target date.
verify: Check the escalation record for the owner acceptance entry.
Pass when the record shows owner acceptance with a date.

steps.title: Add the item to the governance committee agenda pack
sop: Add the escalation to the next underwriting governance committee agenda in SharePoint.
Attach the exposure analysis and the root cause statement to the pack.
Done when the item and its evidence appear in the agenda pack.
verify: Open the circulated agenda pack and locate the item.
Pass when the escalation appears with its supporting analysis attached.

steps.title: Brief the Chief Underwriting Officer on the systemic issue
sop: Review the escalation, exposure and proposed remediation ahead of committee.
Direct any immediate underwriting action such as a referral or appetite change.
Done when the CUO briefing and any directed action are recorded.
verify: Check the escalation record for the CUO briefing note.
Pass when the record shows the briefing date and any directed action.

generic.Defined scope/population: All defects logged in the QA cycle across every line of business, underwriter and state.
generic.In-scope period: The current QA cycle compared against the prior cycles used for recurrence testing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every defect carries defect type, line of business, underwriter and state for pivoting.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pivot totals by defect type equal the cycle defect count in the GRC platform.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Cluster analysis workbook retained with the extract date and defect log snapshot.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Clusters assessed as seasonal rather than systemic recorded with the supporting rationale.
generic.Test population: All defect clusters produced from the cycle pivot by type, line and underwriter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Each systemic finding supported by at least three cited policy numbers.
generic.Exception handling path: Contested clusters referred to the Underwriting Quality / Audit Manager for a ruling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Clusters shown by defect type, line of business and underwriter with cited evidence.
generic.Evidence location: Cluster workbook in Excel with the published view in Power BI and defects in the GRC platform.

steps.title: Extract the cycle defect log from the GRC platform
sop: Export all defects for the cycle with type, line of business, underwriter and state.
Check every row carries the four pivot fields and fix blanks at source.
Done when the extract is complete with no blank pivot fields.
verify: Compare the extract row count to the GRC cycle defect total.
Pass when the extract count equals the logged cycle defect count.

steps.title: Pivot the defect log to expose clustering in Excel
sop: Pivot defect counts by type, line of business, underwriter and state.
Rank the cells with the highest concentration as candidate clusters.
Done when candidate clusters are listed with their defect counts.
verify: Cross-total the pivot against the extract row count.
Pass when pivot totals reconcile to the extract with no lost rows.

steps.title: Split rating errors from form errors
sop: Classify rating errors such as wrong class code, missing schedule credit or ITV shortfall.
Classify form errors such as wrong edition date or missing mandatory endorsement.
Done when every clustered defect sits in a rating or form error class.
verify: Sample ten classified defects against their defect narrative.
Pass when each sampled classification matches the recorded defect detail.

steps.title: Test whether the cluster follows a guideline, system default or person
sop: Trace each cluster to the guideline clause, system default value or individual underwriter behind it.
Reproduce the error path in the underwriting workflow where a system default is suspected.
Done when each cluster has an identified originating cause.
verify: Review the traced cause against the sample policies in the cluster.
Pass when the identified cause explains the defects in the sampled policies.

steps.title: Quantify recurrence against prior cycles in Power BI
sop: Compare each cluster rate against the same measure in the prior two cycles.
Discount clusters explained by seasonality or a one-off portfolio event.
Done when each cluster is marked systemic or non-systemic with its recurrence rate.
verify: Recompute two recurrence rates from the prior cycle extracts.
Pass when the recurrence rates reproduce from the prior cycle data.

steps.title: Document each systemic error with cited policy evidence
sop: Write one finding per confirmed systemic error with cause and recurrence.
Cite at least three policy numbers as evidence for each finding.
Done when every systemic finding carries three or more cited policies.
verify: Count cited policies per finding and open one citation per finding.
Pass when no systemic finding has fewer than three verifiable citations.

steps.title: Review the systemic findings set with the audit manager
sop: Challenge each finding on cause, recurrence and evidence sufficiency.
Confirm or reject each finding and record the decision in the GRC platform.
Done when every candidate finding is confirmed or rejected with a reason.
verify: Check the finding set for undecided entries.
Pass when no candidate systemic finding is left without a recorded decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: All files reviewed and defects logged in the quarter across every underwriter and line of business.
generic.In-scope period: The completed quarter with quarter-over-quarter comparison to the prior quarter.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Defect rate by underwriter, line and category populated with prior-quarter comparatives.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Dashboard files reviewed and defect counts reconcile to the QA defect log.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed-off report PDF filed with the quarter, issue date and dashboard refresh timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Excluded reviews or restated prior figures recorded with the reason for the change.
generic.Test population: The issued quarterly report sections and the dashboard values they cite.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Report totals match the defect log with no unexplained variance.
generic.Exception handling path: Reconciliation differences resolved with the Underwriting Quality Analyst before issue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Issued report shows defect trends, prior-action closure status and recommendations with owners.
generic.Evidence location: Signed PDF in the QA SharePoint library with source views in Power BI and the GRC platform.

steps.title: Refresh the QA dashboard for the quarter in Power BI
sop: Refresh the QA dataset to the quarter cut-off date and record the refresh timestamp.
Check files reviewed and defect counts populate for every underwriter and line.
Done when the dashboard shows the full quarter with a recorded refresh time.
verify: Compare dashboard files reviewed and defects to the GRC defect log.
Pass when dashboard totals equal the defect log totals for the quarter.

steps.title: Build the defect rate views by underwriter, line and category
sop: Produce defect rate by underwriter, line of business and defect category.
Add the prior quarter comparative and the movement for each view.
Done when each view shows current, prior and movement values.
verify: Recompute two defect rates from the underlying counts.
Pass when recomputed rates match the reported values.

steps.title: Report closure status of prior-quarter corrective actions
sop: Extract prior-quarter corrective actions from the GRC platform with their status.
Age anything still open against its due date and list the overdue items.
Done when closure status and ageing for prior actions are compiled.
verify: Reconcile the action list to the GRC corrective action register.
Pass when every prior-quarter action appears with a current status.

steps.title: Write the improvement recommendations section
sop: Link each systemic finding in the quarter to a recommended action.
Name an owner for every recommendation and state the target date.
Done when every systemic finding carries a recommendation, owner and date.
verify: Check each systemic finding against the recommendation list.
Pass when no systemic finding is left without an owned recommendation.

steps.title: Reconcile report figures to the source before issue
sop: Tie every stated figure in the report back to the dashboard or defect log.
Document any restatement of prior-quarter figures with the reason.
Done when every reported figure has a traced source value.
verify: Re-check three figures at random against the source system.
Pass when all checked figures reconcile with no unexplained difference.

steps.title: Obtain review from the Underwriting Director / Manager
sop: Review the report for accuracy, tone and the practicality of recommendations.
Record acceptance or requested changes before circulation.
Done when the review outcome is recorded on the draft.
verify: Check the draft carries the reviewer name and review date.
Pass when the report shows a recorded management review before issue.

steps.title: Circulate and file the signed-off report
sop: Circulate the report to the Underwriting Director / Manager and the CUO.
File the signed-off PDF in the QA library with the quarter in the file name.
Done when the report is circulated and the signed PDF is filed.
verify: Open the filed PDF and check the distribution list is recorded.
Pass when the filed report shows the issue date and distribution list.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every bound policy on the locked QA sample list for the review cycle.
generic.In-scope period: The bind period covered by the locked QA sample for the cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: All four scoring criteria completed per file with reviewer name and review date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scored file count equals the locked sample file count for the cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scoring worksheet saved per file with the rubric version and review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Files that cannot be scored recorded with the reason and a replacement decision.
generic.Test population: All sampled bound files scored in the cycle against the guideline checklist.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Form edition dates and applied rates match the approved form and rate library.
generic.Exception handling path: Scoring doubts referred to the Senior Underwriter before the score is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each file shows a score on rate adequacy, form selection, authority and documentation.
generic.Evidence location: Scoring worksheets in Excel with source records in the policy administration system.

steps.title: Open each sampled policy in the policy administration system
sop: Open each file on the locked sample list alongside the QA scoring worksheet.
Confirm the policy matches the sample row on insured, effective date and underwriter.
Done when every sampled policy is opened and matched to its worksheet row.
verify: Compare opened policy numbers against the locked sample list.
Pass when every sampled policy is accounted for or logged as unscoreable.

steps.title: Score rate adequacy against the filed rate
sop: Check the rating worksheet, applied class code and schedule credit or debit.
Compare each against the filed rate applicable at the policy effective date.
Done when a rate adequacy score is recorded for every sampled file.
verify: Re-check two files against the filed rate library.
Pass when the applied rate matches the filed rate for the effective date.

steps.title: Score form selection against the approved form library
sop: Confirm the policy form edition date against the approved form library for the state.
Confirm mandatory state endorsements are attached to the issued policy.
Done when a form selection score is recorded for every sampled file.
verify: Re-check two files against the approved form register.
Pass when issued form editions equal the approved editions for that state.

steps.title: Score authority compliance in the underwriting workstation
sop: Compare limits, premium and hazard grade against the binding underwriter authority.
Confirm referrals were raised and approved where a trigger applied.
Done when an authority compliance score is recorded for every sampled file.
verify: Re-check the authority matrix entry for the binding user on two files.
Pass when no scored file shows a bind outside authority without an approved referral.

steps.title: Score file documentation completeness
sop: Check loss runs, application, inspection or loss control report and pricing rationale.
Confirm each document is present, legible and dated before the bind date.
Done when a documentation score is recorded for every sampled file.
verify: Open the document set on two sampled files.
Pass when each scored file shows the required documents present and dated.

steps.title: Refer borderline scoring judgements to the Senior Underwriter
sop: Review files where the analyst cannot settle a criterion against the guideline.
Give the technical ruling and the reasoning for the score.
Done when every referred file has a technical ruling recorded.
verify: Check referred files for a recorded ruling and rationale.
Pass when no referred file is scored without the technical ruling.

steps.title: Finalise and file the scored worksheets
sop: Add reviewer name, review date and rubric version to each completed worksheet.
Save the worksheets to the QA cycle folder in the agreed naming convention.
Done when every scored worksheet is complete and filed.
verify: Count filed worksheets against the locked sample size.
Pass when every sampled file has a filed worksheet with all four scores.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every scored criterion on every reviewed file in the QA cycle that failed the rubric.
generic.In-scope period: The QA review cycle whose scoring has been completed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each defect carries policy number, underwriter, classification, severity and justification.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Logged defects equal the count of failed criteria across the scored worksheets.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scoring worksheet and screenshot attached to each defect with the review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Files reviewed with no defect recorded as an explicit pass with the reviewer name.
generic.Test population: All defect records raised for the cycle in the GRC platform.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every defect carries a classification, a severity and attached evidence.
generic.Exception handling path: Severity disagreements escalated to the Underwriting Quality / Audit Manager for ruling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No reviewed file left with a score but no defect record or explicit pass record.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform defect records with worksheets held in Excel on the QA cycle folder.

steps.title: Enter per-criterion scores into the QA defect log
sop: Key the four criterion scores against policy number and underwriter in the GRC platform.
Check each entry against the scored worksheet before saving.
Done when every reviewed file has its criterion scores recorded.
verify: Compare logged score rows to the filed worksheets.
Pass when every scored worksheet has a matching score entry in the log.

steps.title: Raise one defect record per failed criterion
sop: Create a separate defect record for each criterion that failed on a file.
Never combine multiple failed criteria into one record for a file.

verify: Compare defect count to failed criteria across the worksheets.
Pass when no file with multiple failures carries a single combined defect.

steps.title: Classify each defect by type
sop: Classify as rating error, form error, authority breach, documentation gap or appetite breach.
Use the defect narrative and the failed criterion to choose the class.
Done when every defect record carries a classification.
verify: Filter the cycle defects for a blank classification.
Pass when no defect record is left unclassified.

steps.title: Assign severity using the rubric and record the justification
sop: Apply the rubric on financial impact, regulatory exposure and recurrence.
Write the severity justification into the defect record.
Done when every defect carries a severity and a written justification.
verify: Sample five defects and re-apply the severity rubric.
Pass when sampled severities reproduce from the rubric and the justification.

steps.title: Attach evidence to each defect record
sop: Attach the scoring worksheet and the supporting file screenshot to each defect.
Confirm the attachment opens and shows the cited policy detail.
Done when no defect is saved without its evidence attached.
verify: Open attachments on a sample of defect records.
Pass when every sampled defect has legible evidence attached.

steps.title: Record explicit pass results for clean files
sop: Record an explicit pass entry for each reviewed file with no failed criterion.
Include reviewer name and review date on the pass record.
Done when every clean reviewed file carries a pass record.
verify: Reconcile defects plus pass records against files reviewed.
Pass when every reviewed file has either a defect or a pass record.

steps.title: Review the logged defect set for consistency
sop: Review classification and severity consistency across the cycle defects.
Adjust any misclassified or misgraded defect and record the change reason.
Done when the cycle defect set has been reviewed and adjusted.
verify: Check adjusted defects carry a recorded change reason.
Pass when the reviewed defect set shows consistent classification and severity.

generic.Defined scope/population: All policies bound in the period extracted from the policy administration system with underwriter and line.
generic.In-scope period: The bind period defined for the QA review cycle in the approved methodology.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every population row carries underwriter, line of business, state and premium.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Extract bound policy count reconciles to the policy system control report for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Locked sample list saved with the extract date and the recorded selection query or seed.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Files removed from the sample logged with the reason and the replacement drawn.
generic.Test population: The locked sample list for the cycle with random and targeted flags.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Sample size equals or exceeds the approved minimum percentage of the bound population.
generic.Exception handling path: Shortfalls against the minimum rate escalated to the Underwriting Quality / Audit Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Locked list shows a random or targeted flag per file and the recorded selection query.
generic.Evidence location: QA cycle folder in SharePoint holding the locked list and the Excel selection workbook.

steps.title: Extract the bound policy population from the policy administration system
sop: Extract policies bound in the period with underwriter, line of business, state and premium.
Check for blank underwriter or state values and correct them at source.
Done when the population extract is complete with no blank key fields.
verify: Compare extract counts to the policy system control report.
Pass when the extract bound count equals the system control total.

steps.title: Apply the risk stratification in Excel
sop: Stratify by premium band, new versus renewal, new-underwriter flag and prior-defect flag.
Confirm every population row falls into exactly one stratum per dimension.
Done when the population is fully stratified with no unclassified rows.
verify: Sum the strata counts against the population total.
Pass when strata totals reconcile to the full bound population.

steps.title: Draw the random component at the approved rate
sop: Draw the random sample at the rate set in the approved methodology.
Record the seed or query used so the draw is reproducible.
Done when the random component is drawn and its seed recorded.
verify: Re-run the recorded seed or query against the same population.
Pass when the rerun reproduces an identical random sample list.

steps.title: Add the targeted overlay files
sop: Add above-authority files, new product files and prior repeat-finding files.
Mark each added file as targeted rather than random on the sample list.
Done when all overlay files are added and flagged as targeted.
verify: Filter the sample list by flag and check overlay trigger evidence.
Pass when every targeted file maps to a documented overlay trigger.

steps.title: Confirm the sample meets the approved minimum
sop: Compare the drawn sample size against the approved minimum percentage of the population.
Direct an additional draw where the sample falls short.
Done when the sample size meets or exceeds the approved minimum.
verify: Recompute sample size as a percentage of the bound population.
Pass when the computed percentage meets the approved minimum rate.

steps.title: Confirm file availability with UW Operations
sop: Check the sampled files are retrievable and not locked by an in-flight endorsement.
Flag any file that cannot be produced and propose a replacement.
Done when every sampled file is confirmed retrievable or replaced.
verify: Check replacement files carry a logged reason and stratum match.
Pass when no sampled file is unavailable without a logged replacement.

steps.title: Publish and lock the sample list to the QA cycle folder
sop: Save the final sample list with the extract date and the recorded selection query.
Lock the list to read-only before any scoring begins.
Done when the locked sample list is published to the QA cycle folder.
verify: Open the published list and check it is read-only and dated.
Pass when the locked list predates the first scoring entry for the cycle.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every sampled policy in the QA cycle with a rating worksheet in the policy administration system.
generic.In-scope period: Policies with effective dates inside the QA cycle bind period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rate version, exposure basis, credits and charged premium captured on every sampled file.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recalculated premium compared to charged premium on every file with the variance recorded.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Recalculation workbook saved per cycle with the rate library version used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Premium variances outside tolerance logged with the authority evidence or a raised defect.
generic.Test population: All sampled files subject to rate validation in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Applied rate version matches the filed rate effective at policy inception.
generic.Exception handling path: Unauthorised deviations raised as defects and referred to the Senior Underwriter.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No sampled file left without a recorded premium variance or an explicit nil variance.
generic.Evidence location: Recalculation workbook in Excel with rating worksheets in the policy administration system.

steps.title: Open the rating worksheet for each sampled policy
sop: Open the rating worksheet in the policy administration system for each sampled file.
Record the rate version applied and the policy effective date.
Done when rate version and effective date are recorded for every sampled file.
verify: Compare the recorded rate version to the filed version for that effective date.
Pass when every file shows the filed rate version effective at inception.

steps.title: Re-key the exposure basis from source documents
sop: Re-key class code, payroll or receipts or TIV and territory from the application.
Compare against the inspection report where one exists on the file.
Done when the exposure basis is re-keyed and compared for every file.
verify: Check re-keyed values against the rated values in the workstation.
Pass when no exposure mismatch is left without a raised exception.

steps.title: Recalculate schedule rating and IRPM adjustments
sop: Recalculate each schedule credit or debit applied on the sampled policy.
Confirm each carries a written justification within the underwriter authority.
Done when every applied credit or debit is recalculated and evidenced.
verify: Check justification text and authority level on two adjusted files.
Pass when every credit or debit shows documented justification within authority.

steps.title: Confirm minimum premium and filed rate deviations
sop: Check minimum premium rules were applied where the calculated premium fell below.
Confirm any deviation from filed rates was authorised per the authority matrix.
Done when minimum premium and deviation authority are confirmed per file.
verify: Trace deviation approvals to the authority matrix entry.
Pass when no deviation exists without a recorded approval at the correct level.

steps.title: Record the premium variance per file in Excel
sop: Enter recalculated premium against charged premium for each sampled file.
Record the variance amount or an explicit nil variance on the result line.
Done when every sampled file carries a variance value.
verify: Filter the workbook for blank variance cells.
Pass when no sampled file is left without a variance or nil variance entry.

steps.title: Refer material variances to the Senior Underwriter
sop: Review files where the variance exceeds tolerance and no authority is evidenced.
Confirm whether the charged premium was defensible or the file is defective.
Done when every material variance carries a technical conclusion.
verify: Check referred files for a recorded conclusion and rationale.
Pass when no material variance is closed without a technical conclusion.

steps.title: Log rate validation results back to the QA cycle record
sop: Transfer the per-file validation result to the QA scoring record for the cycle.
Raise a defect for each unauthorised deviation or exposure mismatch.
Done when every validation result is reflected in the QA cycle record.
verify: Reconcile validation result rows to the QA cycle sample list.
Pass when every sampled file shows a recorded rate validation outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every sampled underwriting file in the audit, tested for state form, rate and disclosure compliance.
generic.In-scope period: The audit period covering policies issued, declined or non-renewed in the engagement window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: State, form edition, rate version and disclosure dates captured for every sampled file.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Files assessed equal the sampled files listed in the engagement scope memo.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Working paper per file retained with the tester name, test date and form register version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each exception logged with state, requirement, policy number and remediation owner.
generic.Test population: All sampled files subject to regulatory compliance testing in the engagement.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Filed and approved form editions and all required state disclosures present on file.
generic.Exception handling path: Suspected regulatory breaches escalated to the Underwriting Director / Manager immediately.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each exception mapped to a named regulatory requirement and the state that imposes it.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform exception records with file evidence held in OpenText Document Mgmt.

steps.title: Confirm form and endorsement editions are filed in each state
sop: Open each sampled file in the policy administration system and list the forms attached.
Check each form and endorsement edition against the approved filing for that state.
Done when every sampled file has its form editions checked against the state filing.
verify: Re-check two files against the filed forms register.
Pass when issued form editions match the filed and approved editions for the state.

steps.title: Confirm the applied rate is the filed rate for the state
sop: Compare the rate version applied to the filed rate for the state and effective date.
For prior-approval states confirm approval was granted before the rate was used.
Done when rate conformity is confirmed for every sampled file.
verify: Trace two rate versions to the SERFF disposition date.
Pass when no prior-approval state file used a rate before its approval date.

steps.title: Confirm required consumer disclosures were issued and dated
sop: Check the application disclosure, notice of information practices and fraud warning.
Confirm each is on file, signed where required and dated within the state timeframe.
Done when disclosure completeness is confirmed for every sampled file.
verify: Open the disclosure set on two files in OpenText Document Mgmt.
Pass when every required disclosure is present and dated on the sampled files.

steps.title: Test adverse decision notices on declined and non-renewed risks
sop: Identify sampled files that were declined or non-renewed in the period.
Confirm a notice with reasons was issued within the state notice timeframe.
Done when every adverse decision file has its notice tested.
verify: Compare notice dates to the state timeframe requirement.
Pass when no adverse decision lacks a timely notice stating reasons.

steps.title: Log every exception in the GRC platform
sop: Raise an exception record for each failed test with state, requirement and policy number.
Assign a remediation owner and target date on each exception.
Done when every failed test has a logged exception with an owner.
verify: Reconcile exception records to failed test lines in the working papers.
Pass when every failed test line has a matching exception record.

steps.title: Review the exception set with the audit manager
sop: Review each exception for correct requirement mapping and proportionate severity.
Confirm or adjust the mapping and record the decision.
Done when every exception is reviewed and its mapping confirmed.
verify: Check exceptions carry a named regulatory requirement reference.
Pass when no exception is left without a mapped requirement and state.

steps.title: Notify underwriting management of material breaches
sop: Review exceptions rated as material regulatory breaches.
Direct immediate remediation such as reissue, endorsement or notice.
Done when directed remediation is recorded against each material exception.
verify: Check material exceptions for a recorded management direction.
Pass when every material breach shows a directed remediation and owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: The portfolio extract for the audit period by underwriter, line of business and state.
generic.In-scope period: The audit period defined in the engagement scope for the pre-audit analysis.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Premium, loss ratio, hit ratio, referral rate and authority usage populated per underwriter.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Extract premium total agrees to the policy administration system control report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Analysis pack saved with the extract date and the dashboard refresh timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Anomalies dismissed as explained recorded with the rationale and the reviewer name.
generic.Test population: All underwriters, lines and states represented in the audit period extract.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Anomaly flags produced for every underwriter, line and state in the period.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled extract differences referred to the UW Operations Manager before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Analysis pack names the segments that will drive the targeted audit sample.
generic.Evidence location: Pre-audit pack in SharePoint with views in Power BI and source data in Excel.

steps.title: Pull the period portfolio extract from the policy administration system
sop: Extract premium, loss ratio, hit ratio, referral rate and authority usage for the period.
Break the extract by underwriter, line of business and state.
Done when the extract covers the full audit period at the required breakdown.
verify: Compare extract premium to the policy system control report.
Pass when extract premium equals the system control total for the period.

steps.title: Reconcile the extract with UW Operations
sop: Review the reconciliation line between the extract and the control report.
Explain and document any difference before the analysis proceeds.
Done when the reconciliation is agreed and any difference documented.
verify: Check the reconciliation tab shows the agreed explanation.
Pass when no unexplained premium difference remains in the reconciliation.

steps.title: Flag portfolio anomalies in Power BI
sop: Flag negative rate change on loss-making segments and unusual credit usage.
Flag spikes in bind-without-referral and out-of-appetite classes written.
Done when every anomaly rule has been run over the period extract.
verify: Trace two flagged anomalies back to the underlying policies.
Pass when each flagged anomaly reproduces from the source policy rows.

steps.title: Compare underwriters against peer-group medians
sop: Build peer groups by line and territory and compute the median for each metric.
List underwriters falling outside the peer range on any metric.
Done when the outlier list is produced for every peer group.
verify: Recompute one peer median from the underlying rows.
Pass when the recomputed median matches the reported peer median.

steps.title: Name the segments driving the targeted sample
sop: Select the anomaly segments and outliers that justify a targeted file pull.
Record the rationale for each selected and each rejected segment.
Done when the targeted segment list is agreed with rationale.
verify: Check each selected segment traces to a flagged anomaly or outlier.
Pass when no targeted segment is selected without supporting analysis.

steps.title: Publish the pre-audit analysis pack
sop: Assemble anomaly flags, peer comparison and targeted segment list into the pack.
Publish it to the audit engagement folder in SharePoint with the extract date.
Done when the pack is published with its extract date recorded.
verify: Open the published pack and check the extract date and reconciliation line.
Pass when the pack shows the reconciliation and the named target segments.

steps.title: Hand the analysis to the sampling step
sop: Brief the sampling owner on the segments requiring targeted coverage.
Confirm the sample plan will cover every named segment.
Done when the handover and coverage confirmation are recorded.
verify: Compare the sample plan segments to the pre-audit target list.
Pass when every named segment appears in the planned sample coverage.

generic.Defined scope/population: Findings in the current register that repeat a control tested in the prior two audit cycles.
generic.In-scope period: The current audit cycle compared against the previous two completed cycles.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Repeat flag, board committee reference and enhanced monitoring setting populated per finding.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Repeat findings flagged by the GRC rule equal repeat findings identified manually.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Confirmation record retained with the finding IDs examined and the test date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Repeat findings without an escalation recorded with the reason and a remediation owner.
generic.Test population: All findings in the current register tested for repetition against prior cycles.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every repeat finding carries the escalation flag and a board risk committee reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing escalations raised to the Chief Underwriting Officer for immediate routing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Repeat underwriting findings appear as a standing agenda item with enhanced monitoring noted.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform findings register with agenda evidence in SharePoint and rates in Power BI.

steps.title: Compare the current findings register against prior cycles
sop: Export current findings and the prior two cycles from the GRC platform.
Match on control reference to identify findings repeating on the same control.
Done when the repeat finding list is produced with its finding IDs.
verify: Re-match two repeat findings on control reference across cycles.
Pass when each listed repeat finding maps to the same control in a prior cycle.

steps.title: Confirm the GRC repeat-finding rule is active
sop: Open the automation rule configuration and confirm it is enabled.
Check the rule fired on the identified repeat records.
Done when rule status and firing are confirmed on the repeat set.
verify: Compare rule-flagged records to the manual repeat list.
Pass when the rule flags every manually identified repeat finding.

steps.title: Verify routing to the board risk committee
sop: Check each repeat finding carries a board risk committee agenda reference.
Chase any repeat finding with no routing evidence in SharePoint.
Done when every repeat finding shows a committee reference or a logged chase.
verify: Open the committee agenda and locate the referenced findings.
Pass when every repeat finding appears on a board risk committee agenda.

steps.title: Verify enhanced monitoring has been applied
sop: Check the QA sample rate for the affected underwriter or line in Power BI.
Confirm the rate actually increased rather than only being agreed.
Done when the applied sample rate change is evidenced per repeat finding.
verify: Compare current sample rate to the pre-escalation rate.
Pass when the sample rate for each affected area shows an actual increase.

steps.title: Confirm management ownership of repeat themes
sop: Review the repeat findings and confirm the assigned remediation owner is correct.
Reassign where the owner cannot influence the control and record the change.
Done when every repeat finding has a confirmed accountable owner.
verify: Check owner acceptance entries on the repeat findings.
Pass when no repeat finding is left without an accepted owner.

steps.title: Record the escalation trigger test result
sop: Write the confirmation record listing the finding IDs examined and results.
Note any repeat finding that failed the escalation test and the corrective step.
Done when the trigger test record is saved with its finding IDs.
verify: Open the saved record and check it lists every examined finding ID.
Pass when the record covers all repeat findings with a stated outcome.

steps.title: Confirm the escalation position with the CUO
sop: Review the repeat findings, escalation status and enhanced monitoring evidence.
Confirm the position or direct further action before the committee meeting.
Done when the CUO confirmation or direction is recorded.
verify: Check the record for the CUO confirmation entry and date.
Pass when the CUO confirmation is recorded before the committee date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every exception raised during fieldwork that is being written up as an audit finding.
generic.In-scope period: The audit engagement period stated in the approved scope memo.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Condition, criteria, cause, effect, recommendation, severity, owner and target date per finding.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tested sample size and exception counts in the report reconcile to the working papers.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft report versioned with the author, date and linked working paper references.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Fieldwork exceptions not raised as findings recorded with the reason for exclusion.
generic.Test population: All findings included in the draft audit report for the engagement.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every finding carries a severity rating, a named owner and a target date.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed findings resolved with the Underwriting Director / Manager before the report is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No draft finding without a linked evidence reference to the working papers.
generic.Evidence location: Draft report in SharePoint with findings and evidence links in the GRC platform.

steps.title: Write each finding in condition, criteria, cause, effect and recommendation form
sop: Draft each finding using the five-part structure with the tested sample size.
State the exception count and the population it was drawn from.
Done when every finding is written in the five-part structure.
verify: Check each finding contains all five sections and the sample data.
Pass when no finding is missing a section or its sample and exception counts.

steps.title: Reconcile sample and exception counts to the working papers
sop: Trace each stated sample size and exception count back to the working paper.
Correct any figure that does not reconcile before the draft advances.
Done when every stated count is traced to a working paper reference.
verify: Re-check two findings against their working papers.
Pass when the report counts equal the working paper counts.

steps.title: Rate severity using financial, regulatory and recurrence criteria
sop: Rate each finding Critical, Major or Minor against the severity criteria.
Write the rationale for the rating into the finding.
Done when every finding carries a severity rating and rationale.
verify: Re-apply the criteria to two findings.
Pass when the recorded severity reproduces from the stated rationale.

steps.title: Assign a remediation owner and target date
sop: Name an individual owner for each finding rather than a team or function.
Set a target date proportionate to the severity rating.
Done when every finding has a named owner and a target date.
verify: Filter the finding set for blank owner or date fields.
Pass when no finding is left without a named owner and target date.

steps.title: Cross-reference findings to standards and regulations
sop: Map each finding to the underwriting standard or regulatory requirement it breaches.
Record the reference in the finding record in the GRC platform.
Done when every finding carries a standard or regulation reference.
verify: Check the mapped references resolve to a live standard or requirement.
Pass when no finding cites a withdrawn or non-existent reference.

steps.title: Link evidence references to each draft finding
sop: Attach or link the working paper evidence to each finding in the GRC platform.
Confirm each link opens and shows the cited exception.
Done when every draft finding carries a working evidence link.
verify: Open evidence links on a sample of findings.
Pass when no draft finding is left without a resolvable evidence link.

steps.title: Circulate the draft for management response
sop: Circulate the draft findings to underwriting management for their response.
Record the response received against each finding in the GRC platform.
Done when a management response is recorded against every finding.
verify: Check the draft for findings without a recorded response.
Pass when every finding carries a management response before issue.

generic.Defined scope/population: All files selected for audit fieldwork covering authority, referral, binder and data accuracy tests.
generic.In-scope period: The engagement period stated in the approved audit scope memo.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each working paper line records the test, the result and the supporting document reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Files tested equal the planned sample size per control in the scope memo.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Working papers retained with tester name, test date and document references.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every exception recorded with its cause and routed into the findings draft.
generic.Test population: All sampled files subject to authority, referral, binder and data accuracy testing.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pre-bind referral approval by an appropriately authorised approver where triggered.
generic.Exception handling path: Authority breaches escalated to the Underwriting Quality / Audit Manager during fieldwork.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No bind transaction executed by a user outside the authority matrix for that risk.
generic.Evidence location: Fieldwork working papers in Excel with source records in the policy administration system.

steps.title: Compare the binding user against the authority matrix
sop: Open each sampled file and read the binding user, premium, limit, line and hazard class.
Compare each against the binding user authority in the authority matrix.
Done when authority compliance is tested on every sampled file.
verify: Re-test two files against the current authority matrix version.
Pass when no bind sits outside the binding user authority without approval.

steps.title: Test pre-bind referral approvals
sop: Identify files where a referral trigger applied and check a referral was raised.
Confirm approval predates bind and came from the next authority level.
Done when referral compliance is tested on every triggered file.
verify: Compare referral approval timestamps to bind timestamps on two files.
Pass when every triggered file shows a pre-bind approval at the correct level.

steps.title: Test written confirmation of verbal binders
sop: Identify sampled files bound verbally from the file notes and binder records.
Confirm written confirmation was issued within 24 hours and documented.
Done when every verbal binder in the sample is tested.
verify: Check confirmation timestamps against the verbal bind time.
Pass when no verbal binder lacks written confirmation inside 24 hours.

steps.title: Check policy data accuracy against source documents
sop: Compare named insured, effective dates, limits and deductibles against the application.
Compare the same fields against the issued binder.
Done when data accuracy is tested on every sampled file.
verify: Re-check two files field by field against the signed application.
Pass when no data mismatch is left without a recorded exception.

steps.title: Confirm technical judgement on borderline authority cases
sop: Review files where the authority position depends on hazard class or risk interpretation.
Give the technical view on whether a referral should have fired.
Done when every borderline case carries a technical view.
verify: Check the recorded technical view on the borderline files.
Pass when no borderline case is concluded without a technical view.

steps.title: Record pass or exception per test step in the working paper
sop: Record the result for each test step against each file in the working paper.
Attach the supporting document reference for every result line.
Done when every test step has a recorded result and reference.
verify: Filter the working paper for blank result or reference cells.
Pass when no test line is left without a result and a document reference.

steps.title: Review completed fieldwork with the audit manager
sop: Review the working papers for completeness and consistent conclusions.
Confirm each exception is supported before it feeds the findings draft.
Done when the fieldwork is reviewed and signed by the audit manager.
verify: Check the working paper for the reviewer name and review date.
Pass when the completed fieldwork carries a manager review signature.

generic.Defined scope/population: The audit universe of every line, distribution channel, delegated authority and underwriting location.
generic.In-scope period: The forward annual audit plan year being scheduled.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each universe entity carries a risk rank, lead reviewer, fieldwork window and reporting date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scheduled engagements cover every universe entity within its coverage interval.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved plan stored with version number, CUO approval name and approval date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Entities deferred beyond their coverage interval logged with the CUO approved rationale.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No audit universe entity without a scheduled engagement inside its coverage interval.
generic.Exception handling path: Coverage gaps escalated to the Chief Underwriting Officer before plan approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approved plan covers all lines and channels with CUO sign-off date recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Approved plan in the audit library in SharePoint with entities logged in the GRC platform.

steps.title: Build the audit universe in Excel
sop: List every line of business, distribution channel and delegated authority arrangement.
Add each underwriting location and confirm nothing active is missing.
Done when the universe lists every auditable underwriting entity.
verify: Cross-check the universe against the product and channel catalogues.
Pass when no active line, channel or location is absent from the universe.

steps.title: Risk-rank each universe entity
sop: Score each entity on premium, loss ratio volatility, regulatory exposure and prior findings.
Combine scores into a risk rank and set the coverage interval per rank.
Done when every entity carries a risk rank and coverage interval.
verify: Recompute the rank for two entities from the component scores.
Pass when the recomputed ranks match the recorded ranks.

steps.title: Schedule engagements across the plan year
sop: Place each entity in the calendar so it is covered within its interval.
Level the workload so fieldwork windows do not collide across reviewers.
Done when every entity has a scheduled engagement in the plan year.
verify: Check each entity last audit date against the schedule.
Pass when no entity exceeds its maximum coverage interval under the plan.

steps.title: Assign lead reviewer, fieldwork window and reporting date
sop: Assign a lead reviewer to each engagement with the required skills.
Set the fieldwork window and the reporting date for each engagement.
Done when every engagement has a reviewer, window and reporting date.
verify: Filter the plan for engagements missing any of the three fields.
Pass when no engagement is left without reviewer, window and reporting date.

steps.title: Review the plan with underwriting management
sop: Review the coverage and timing against known underwriting change and busy periods.
Raise conflicts and agree adjustments before the plan goes for approval.
Done when management review comments are incorporated or rejected with reason.
verify: Check the plan change log against the review comments.
Pass when every management comment shows an accepted or rejected disposition.

steps.title: Obtain CUO approval of the annual plan
sop: Review the universe, risk ranks and coverage for completeness.
Approve the plan and record the approval name and date on the front sheet.
Done when the plan carries a recorded CUO approval and date.
verify: Open the approved plan and read the approval block.
Pass when the plan shows CUO sign-off with a date and version number.

steps.title: Publish the approved plan to the audit library
sop: Store the approved plan in the audit library with the year and version in the name.
Load the engagements into the GRC platform audit schedule.
Done when the plan is published and the engagements are loaded.
verify: Compare GRC scheduled engagements to the approved plan rows.
Pass when every planned engagement exists in the GRC audit schedule.

generic.Defined scope/population: All findings from the completed audit engagement being presented to leadership.

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Findings presented equal the findings in the issued report for the engagement.

Join it to each scorecard row on underwriter identifier.
Done when every scorecard row carries a QA defect rate.
verify: Check joined defect rates against the QA cycle results.
Pass when no scorecard row is missing its QA defect rate.

steps.title: Compute the composite score and band
sop: Compute the weighted composite score for each underwriter.
Apply the published thresholds to assign exceeds, meets or below.
Done when every underwriter has a composite score and band.
verify: Recompute two composite scores from the weighted components.
Pass when the recomputed scores and bands match the scorecard.

steps.title: Write the commentary line per underwriter
sop: Identify the largest positive and negative variance for each underwriter.
Write a single commentary line covering both.
Done when every underwriter row carries a commentary line.
verify: Check commentary against the variance columns for two rows.
Pass when each commentary reflects the actual largest variances.

steps.title: Review anomalies before publication
sop: Review scores driven by a single large loss or a single large account.
Confirm the score stands or add a footnote explaining the distortion.
Done when every anomalous score is reviewed and dispositioned.
verify: Check anomalous rows carry a footnote or a confirmation.
Pass when no anomalous score is published without review.

steps.title: Version the scorecard and lock the data snapshot
sop: Assign the scorecard version number and record the build date.
Lock the source data snapshot so figures cannot drift after distribution.
Done when the version and locked snapshot are saved together.
verify: Recompute a score from the locked snapshot.
Pass when the locked snapshot reproduces the published scorecard values.

steps.title: Confirm the scorecard with underwriting management
sop: Review the scorecard for fairness, banding and commentary accuracy.
Approve the version for distribution or return it for correction.
Done when the scorecard version is approved for distribution.
verify: Check the scorecard record for the approval entry.
Pass when the published version shows a recorded management approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: Written premium, bound and quoted counts and incurred losses by underwriter and segment.
generic.In-scope period: The benchmarking period at the agreed loss valuation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every row carries underwriter of record, segment, period and valuation date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Extract written premium agrees to the finance control total for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dataset saved dated to the benchmarking folder as the single source for the cycle.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Mid-term transfer splits and attribution overrides logged with the rule applied.
generic.Test population: All rows in the compiled benchmarking dataset for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Extract carries underwriter of record, segment and valuation date on every row.
generic.Exception handling path: Reconciliation differences referred to the UW Operations Manager before the dataset is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reconciliation tab shows extract premium agreed to the finance control total.
generic.Evidence location: Benchmarking folder in SharePoint holding the dated Excel dataset and reconciliation tab.

steps.title: Extract premium, counts and losses from the policy administration system
sop: Extract written premium, bound and quoted counts and incurred losses for the period.
Break the extract by underwriter, segment and period.
Done when the extract covers the full period at the required breakdown.
verify: Check the extract for blank underwriter or segment values.
Pass when every extract row carries an underwriter and a segment.

steps.title: Apply the underwriter attribution rule
sop: Credit the underwriter of record at bind for each policy.
Apply the documented split rule to mid-term transfers and log each split.
Done when every row carries an attributed underwriter of record.
verify: Check the split rule application on transferred policies.
Pass when every transferred policy follows the documented split rule.

steps.title: Join loss data at the agreed valuation date
sop: Join incurred losses using the same valuation date as the prior period.
Record the valuation date on every row of the dataset.
Done when losses are joined at a consistent valuation date.
verify: Compare the valuation date to the prior period dataset.
Pass when the valuation basis matches the prior period exactly.

steps.title: Reconcile written premium to the finance control total
sop: Total the extract written premium and compare against the finance control total.
Document any difference and its cause on the reconciliation tab.
Done when the reconciliation tab is complete for the period.
verify: Re-add the extract premium total.
Pass when the extract total agrees to the finance control total or is explained.

steps.title: Confirm the reconciliation with UW Operations
sop: Review the reconciliation and confirm the explanation for any difference.
Direct correction where the difference indicates an extract error.
Done when the reconciliation is confirmed or a correction is directed.
verify: Check the reconciliation tab for the confirmation entry.
Pass when the reconciliation carries a dated operations confirmation.

steps.title: Save the dated dataset as the single cycle source
sop: Save the dataset to the benchmarking folder with the extract date in the name.
Mark superseded working extracts so only one source remains in use.
Done when the dated dataset is saved as the single source.
verify: Search the folder for competing extract versions.
Pass when only the dated single-source dataset is available for the cycle.
