steps.title: Release the dataset for benchmarking
sop: Review the dataset scope, attribution and reconciliation before release.
Authorise its use as the benchmarking source for the cycle.
Done when the dataset release authorisation is recorded.
verify: Check the dataset record for the release entry and date.
Pass when the released dataset shows a recorded authorisation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every underwriter-level performance metric used in the scorecard and benchmarking pack.
generic.In-scope period: The forward measurement period the definitions will govern.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each metric states numerator, denominator, source field, period, lag and exclusions.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Metrics defined equal the measures used on the published scorecard.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Definition sheet published with a version number, approval date and approver name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Metrics retired or deferred logged with the rationale and approval.
generic.Test population: All metric definitions referenced by the scorecard for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Approved definition sheet states formula, source field and owner for every metric.
generic.Exception handling path: Extraction disputes arbitrated by the named data owner for that metric.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Scorecard measures reference the published metric definition version.
generic.Evidence location: Metric definition sheet in SharePoint with the calculation model held in Excel.

steps.title: Write the formula for each performance metric
sop: Write numerator, denominator and source field for quote-to-bind, premium, rate change and loss ratio.
Confirm each source field exists in the policy administration extract.
Done when every metric has a written formula and named source field.
verify: Test one formula against a sample extract in Excel.
Pass when the formula computes from the named source fields without adjustment.

steps.title: State period, valuation lag and exclusions
sop: State the measurement period and the valuation lag for loss-based metrics.
List exclusions such as cancellations flat and facultative placements.
Done when period, lag and exclusions are stated per metric.
verify: Apply the exclusions to a test population.
Pass when the excluded population matches the stated exclusion rules.

steps.title: Define the credibility threshold
sop: Set the book size or policy count below which an underwriter is reported but not ranked.
State how footnoting applies to sub-threshold underwriters.
Done when the credibility threshold and its treatment are documented.
verify: Apply the threshold to the current underwriter roster.
Pass when the threshold identifies a stable and defensible excluded set.

steps.title: Assign a data owner per metric
sop: Name a data owner for each metric to arbitrate extraction disputes.
Confirm each named owner accepts the role.
Done when every metric carries an accepting named data owner.
verify: Filter the definition sheet for metrics without an owner.
Pass when no metric is left without a named accepting data owner.

steps.title: Review the definitions for consistency with reporting
sop: Check definitions do not conflict with QA, governance or finance reporting measures.
Record and resolve every conflict before approval.
Done when definition conflicts are resolved or documented.
verify: Compare two definitions against the equivalent governance measure.
Pass when no metric definition conflicts with an existing reported measure.

steps.title: Obtain CUO approval of the definition set
sop: Review the formulas, exclusions, thresholds and owners.
Approve the set and record the approval name and date.
Done when the definition sheet carries a recorded CUO approval.
verify: Open the approved sheet and read the approval block.
Pass when the sheet shows CUO name, approval date and version number.

steps.title: Publish the definitions and link them to the scorecard
sop: Publish the definition sheet with its version number to SharePoint.
Reference the version on the scorecard so measures trace to definitions.
Done when the scorecard cites the published definition version.
verify: Open the scorecard and read the cited definition version.
Pass when the scorecard version reference matches the published definitions.

generic.Defined scope/population: Manager-specific scorecard views covering each manager direct reports only.
generic.In-scope period: The scorecard period being distributed to underwriting managers.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Distribution log records date, recipient list and scorecard version for each issue.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Underwriters across manager views equal the scorecard population with no duplicates.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Distributed views retained with the scorecard version and distribution timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Access requests outside the reporting line logged with the decision and approver.
generic.Test population: All manager views issued for the scorecard period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No manager has visibility of underwriters outside their own reporting line.
generic.Exception handling path: Access queries routed to the Underwriting Director / Manager for a decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Distribution entry records date, recipient list and scorecard version.
generic.Evidence location: Distribution log in SharePoint with manager views published in Power BI.

steps.title: Split the scorecard into manager-specific views
sop: Build one view per manager containing only their direct reports.
Check the reporting line source is the current org record.
Done when every manager has a view limited to their direct reports.
verify: Compare each view membership against the reporting line record.
Pass when no view contains an underwriter outside that manager reporting line.

steps.title: Reconcile view membership to the scorecard population
sop: Sum the underwriters across all manager views.
Investigate any underwriter appearing twice or not at all.
Done when view membership reconciles to the scorecard population.
verify: Compare the total across views to the scorecard row count.
Pass when the totals reconcile with no duplicate or missing underwriter.

steps.title: Walk the results in the management meeting
sop: Present cohort movement and any credibility footnotes to the managers.
Explain the metric definition version behind the scores.
Done when the results have been walked with the manager group.
verify: Check the meeting note lists the topics covered.
Pass when the note records cohort movement and footnote discussion.

steps.title: Issue the views through the controlled channel
sop: Publish each view with access limited to the named manager.
Confirm no open link sharing is enabled on any view.
Done when every view is issued with restricted named access.
verify: Review the effective permissions on two views.
Pass when access on every view is limited to the named manager.

steps.title: Record the distribution in the log
sop: Log the distribution date, recipient list and scorecard version.
Attach the issued view references to the log entry.
Done when the distribution log entry is complete for the period.
verify: Open the log entry and check all three fields.
Pass when the entry records date, recipients and scorecard version.

steps.title: Confirm managers have scheduled performance conversations
sop: Confirm each manager has booked one-to-one conversations before the next cycle.
Chase any manager without booked conversations.
Done when every manager confirms their conversations are scheduled.
verify: Check the confirmation list against the manager distribution list.
Pass when every recipient manager has confirmed scheduled conversations.

steps.title: Review access exceptions
sop: Review any request for access beyond a manager own reporting line.
Approve or refuse and record the decision with the reason.
Done when every access request has a recorded decision.
verify: Compare granted access against the recorded decisions.
Pass when no access exists beyond the reporting line without an approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: All underwriters carrying a composite scorecard score within their peer group.
generic.In-scope period: The scorecard period whose composite scores drive the ranking.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each ranked row carries composite score, peer group, key variance and credibility flag.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ranked underwriters plus excluded underwriters equal the scorecard population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Quartile list published tied to the scorecard version and snapshot date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Excluded underwriters footnoted with the credibility or tenure reason.
generic.Test population: All quartile assignments produced for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Top and bottom quartile lists produced within peer groups, not across the whole book.
generic.Exception handling path: Distorted extremes referred to the Underwriting Quality / Audit Manager for review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No underwriter ranked despite falling below the credibility threshold.
generic.Evidence location: Quartile list in the benchmarking folder with source scores in Power BI.

steps.title: Rank underwriters within their peer group
sop: Sort composite scores within each peer group rather than across the whole book.
Assign quartile positions inside each peer group.
Done when every underwriter has a within-peer-group rank.
verify: Check two peer groups for cross-group contamination.
Pass when every ranking is computed inside its own peer group.

steps.title: Apply credibility and tenure exclusions
sop: Exclude underwriters below the credibility threshold or with part-period tenure.
Footnote each exclusion with the reason.
Done when every exclusion is applied and footnoted.
verify: Compare the excluded set to the credibility threshold definition.
Pass when no sub-threshold underwriter appears in a ranked quartile.

steps.title: Produce the top and bottom quartile lists
sop: Produce the top and bottom quartile membership per peer group.
Show each member composite score and key variance.
Done when both quartile lists are produced with scores and variances.
verify: Reconcile quartile membership counts to the ranked population.
Pass when quartile membership reconciles to the ranked underwriter count.

steps.title: Sanity-check the extremes against QA defect rate
sop: Check top and bottom performers against their QA defect rate.
Flag scores driven by a single large loss or a single large account.
Done when every extreme position has been sanity-checked.
verify: Review the flagged extremes and their supporting data.
Pass when every distorted position is flagged or explained.

steps.title: Review the quartile lists with underwriting management
sop: Review both lists for fairness and known contextual factors.
Direct any amendment and record the reason.
Done when the quartile lists are confirmed or amended.
verify: Check amendments carry a recorded reason.
Pass when every amendment to the lists is documented.

steps.title: Publish the quartile list tied to the scorecard version
sop: Publish the lists to the benchmarking folder with the scorecard version stated.
Restrict access to underwriting leadership.
Done when the lists are published with the version reference.
verify: Open the published list and read the version reference.
Pass when the list cites the scorecard version it was derived from.

steps.title: Hand the quartile output to the driver analysis
sop: Provide the cohort membership to the contributing-factor analysis step.
Confirm cohort definitions match the published quartile lists.
Done when the cohort handover is recorded.
verify: Compare the analysis cohorts to the published quartiles.
Pass when analysis cohort membership matches the published lists.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every underwriter with granted authority and their bound premium, limits and referrals in the period.
generic.In-scope period: The review period covering bind and referral activity for the underwriting team.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Granted authority, bound premium, limits and referral counts populated per underwriter.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Referral counts reconcile to referral records in the underwriting workstation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Utilisation analysis retained with the extract date and authority matrix version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Utilisation outliers accepted without action logged with the rationale.
generic.Test population: All underwriters holding binding authority in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Utilisation and referral frequency computed per underwriter against granted authority.
generic.Exception handling path: Suspected authority breaches referred immediately for QA file review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No bound risk exceeding granted authority without a recorded referral approval.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI utilisation views with authority records in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Compute authority utilisation per underwriter
sop: Compare bound premium and limits against granted authority per underwriter.
Compute the utilisation percentage for each authority dimension.
Done when utilisation is computed for every authorised underwriter.
verify: Recompute utilisation for two underwriters from source data.
Pass when the recomputed utilisation matches the reported figure.

steps.title: Flag chronic under-utilisation
sop: Identify underwriters routinely binding far below their granted authority.
Record the pattern as a capability or confidence signal for review.
Done when every under-utilisation case is flagged and described.
verify: Check flagged cases against the bind distribution.
Pass when every flag reflects a sustained pattern rather than one period.

steps.title: Flag unnecessary referrals inside authority
sop: Identify referrals raised on risks that sat inside the underwriter authority.
Quantify the escalation load these referrals create.
Done when unnecessary referral volume is quantified per underwriter.
verify: Sample referred risks and check them against the authority matrix.
Pass when each flagged referral is confirmed to have sat inside authority.

steps.title: Flag zero-referral underwriters where triggers should have fired
sop: Identify books where referral triggers should have fired but no referral exists.
Nominate those files for QA review.
Done when zero-referral anomalies are identified and nominated.
verify: Check the nominated files against the referral trigger rules.
Pass when every nominated file shows a trigger with no raised referral.

steps.title: Test for binds outside granted authority
sop: Compare each bound risk against the binding user granted authority.
Check for a recorded referral approval on any risk above authority.
Done when every bind is tested against granted authority.
verify: Trace two above-authority binds to their referral approval.
Pass when no above-authority bind exists without a recorded approval.

steps.title: Document findings per underwriter
sop: Write the utilisation and referral findings for each underwriter.
State the implication for authority progression or training.
Done when every underwriter has a documented finding.
verify: Filter the underwriter list for missing findings.
Pass when no authorised underwriter is left without a documented finding.

steps.title: Review findings for authority and development decisions
sop: Review the findings against authority progression and training plans.
Direct authority change, coaching or file review as appropriate.
Done when every finding has a directed management decision.
verify: Check the findings for recorded management decisions.
Pass when no finding is left without a recorded decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every filing closed in the period with its full SERFF correspondence trail and disposition.
generic.In-scope period: The archiving period covering filings closed since the last archive run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each record indexed by state, line, filing number, form or rate identifier and approval date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived filings equal the closed filings shown on the filing tracker.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved form and rate PDFs archived with the disposition date and document version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Closed filings with no disposition letter logged and chased with the regulator.
generic.Test population: All filings closed in the period across every state and line of business.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every closed filing has an archived disposition letter indexed by state and filing number.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing archive records escalated to the UW Operations Manager for retrieval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No filing marked Approved without a corresponding archived approval record.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText Document Mgmt archive with the tracker held in SharePoint.

steps.title: Download the correspondence trail from SERFF
sop: Download submission, objection letters, responses and the disposition for each closed filing.
Confirm the trail is complete before the filing is archived.
Done when a complete trail is downloaded for every closed filing.
verify: Compare downloaded documents to the SERFF filing history.
Pass when no correspondence item in SERFF is missing from the download.

steps.title: Index each archived record in OpenText
sop: Index by state, line of business, filing number, form or rate identifier and approval date.
Check the index values against the SERFF filing header.
Done when every archived record carries the full index set.
verify: Search the archive by state and filing number.
Pass when the search returns the correct filing record for each test.

steps.title: Attach the approved form and rate PDFs
sop: Attach the approved form and rate PDFs to the same archive record.
Confirm the attached version matches the approved disposition.
Done when the approved documents sit with the correspondence record.
verify: Open the attached PDFs on two archived filings.
Pass when the archived documents match the approved editions.

steps.title: Reconcile the archive against the filing tracker
sop: Compare archived records to the closed filings on the tracker.
List closed filings with no archived disposition letter.
Done when the reconciliation list is produced.
verify: Count archived records against tracker closed filings.
Pass when the counts reconcile or every gap is listed.

steps.title: Chase missing disposition letters
sop: Chase the regulator or the filing owner for each missing disposition letter.
Log the chase date and the response against the filing record.
Done when every gap has a logged chase and outcome.
verify: Check the gap list for chase entries.
Pass when no gap remains without a logged chase and outcome.

steps.title: Apply retention and disposal review dates
sop: Apply the retention period from the records retention schedule to each record.
Set the disposal review date on every archived filing.
Done when retention and disposal metadata are set on all records.
verify: Read the retention metadata on two archived records.
Pass when every archived record shows retention class and disposal date.

steps.title: Confirm the archive is examination-ready
sop: Test retrieval of a sample filing as an examiner would request it.
Confirm the record produces the trail, approval and forms together.
Done when the retrieval test result is recorded.
verify: Review the retrieval test output against the sample filing.
Pass when the archive returns a complete filing record on request.

generic.Defined scope/population: All underwriters and assistants writing the lines affected by the approved form change.
generic.In-scope period: The window from filing approval to the mandatory use date of the form.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Bulletin states form number, edition date, affected states and lines and the mandatory date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Acknowledgement count reconciles to the distribution list for the affected lines.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Bulletin and marked-up form posted to the guidance library with the issue date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Non-responders after the chase logged and escalated with the manager decision.
generic.Test population: All recipients on the distribution list for the affected lines.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Published bulletin states form number, edition date and mandatory use date.
generic.Exception handling path: Persistent non-acknowledgement escalated to the Underwriting Director / Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No underwriter writing the affected line without a recorded acknowledgement.
generic.Evidence location: Guidance library in SharePoint with acknowledgements tracked in the learning management system.

steps.title: Draft the form change bulletin
sop: State the form number, edition date, affected states and lines and the mandatory use date.
Confirm each detail against the approved filing record.
Done when the bulletin states all required change details.
verify: Compare bulletin details to the SERFF approval record.
Pass when every stated detail matches the approved filing.

steps.title: Explain the underwriting impact
sop: Describe what changes on new business and what changes at renewal.
State any transition rule for in-flight quotes and bound policies.
Done when the impact and transition rules are written into the bulletin.
verify: Test the transition rule against a live in-flight quote scenario.
Pass when the stated rule resolves the in-flight scenario without ambiguity.

steps.title: Build the distribution list for affected lines
sop: List all underwriters and assistants writing the affected lines plus their managers.
Validate the list against the current underwriting roster.
Done when the distribution list covers every affected writer.
verify: Compare the list to the roster for the affected lines.
Pass when no writer of an affected line is missing from the list.

steps.title: Issue the bulletin to the distribution list
sop: Send the bulletin to every recipient on the list with the acknowledgement request.
Record the issue date against the bulletin.
Done when the bulletin is issued and the issue date recorded.
verify: Check the send record against the distribution list.
Pass when every listed recipient received the bulletin.

steps.title: Post the bulletin and marked-up form to the guidance library
sop: Post the bulletin and the marked-up form to the underwriting guidance library.
Link the entry from the affected product guidance page.
Done when the bulletin and form are retrievable from the library.
verify: Search the guidance library for the form number.
Pass when the search returns the bulletin and the marked-up form.

steps.title: Track acknowledgements and chase non-responders
sop: Track acknowledgement in the learning management system against the distribution list.
Chase non-responders before the mandatory use date.
Done when all recipients acknowledge or are chased and logged.
verify: Compare acknowledgement records to the distribution list.
Pass when every recipient shows an acknowledgement or a logged chase.

steps.title: Escalate outstanding non-acknowledgement
sop: Review recipients still unacknowledged at the mandatory use date.
Direct the remedial action such as a stand-up briefing or system block.
Done when every outstanding recipient has a directed action.
verify: Check the escalation list for recorded directions.
Pass when no unacknowledged writer of an affected line is left unaddressed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every state included in the deployment scope for the new or amended form.
generic.In-scope period: The window between filing disposition and the planned form deployment date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Disposition, approved edition date and state effective date recorded per state.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: States confirmed approved equal the states listed in the deployment change request.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval evidence reference recorded against the deployment change request with the check date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: States withheld from deployment logged with the pending or objected status.
generic.Test population: All states in the deployment scope for the form.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Approved disposition recorded for every state included in the deployment.
generic.Exception handling path: Pending or objected states escalated to the UW Operations Manager to re-baseline the release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No form activated in a state whose filing is still pending or objected.
generic.Evidence location: SERFF filing records with the change request held in SharePoint and the policy system.

steps.title: Open the SERFF filing record for each deployment state
sop: Open the filing record in SERFF for every state in the deployment scope.
Read the disposition and record it against the state.
Done when a disposition is recorded for every deployment state.
verify: Compare recorded dispositions to the SERFF portal values.
Pass when every state shows a disposition matching the portal.

steps.title: Match the approved edition date to the deployment package
sop: Read the approved form edition date from each state disposition.
Compare it against the edition being loaded into the policy system.
Done when edition dates are matched for every state.
verify: Re-check two states edition dates against the load package.
Pass when the loaded edition equals the approved edition in every state.

steps.title: Confirm state-specific effective dates
sop: Record the effective date permitted by each state approval.
Confirm no state permits use earlier than its own approved date.
Done when permitted effective dates are recorded per state.
verify: Compare the planned activation dates to the state approved dates.
Pass when no planned activation predates the state approved date.

steps.title: Record approval evidence on the deployment change request
sop: Attach the approval evidence reference to the change request for each state.
Confirm the change request cannot proceed without the evidence.
Done when evidence references are recorded for all deployment states.
verify: Open the change request and check the evidence references.
Pass when every deployment state carries an approval evidence reference.

steps.title: Withhold states without approval
sop: Remove states still showing objection or pending status from the deployment.
Note the exclusion and its reason in the release record.
Done when every unapproved state is withheld and noted.
verify: Compare the release scope to the approved state list.
Pass when the release scope contains only approved states.

steps.title: Authorise the release
sop: Review the approval evidence and the withheld state list.
Authorise the release for the approved states only.
Done when the release authorisation is recorded.
verify: Check the change request for the authorisation entry.
Pass when the release shows a recorded authorisation before deployment.

steps.title: Confirm activation matches the approved scope
sop: Check the policy administration system after deployment for active states.
Confirm no withheld state has the form available for selection.
Done when post-deployment activation is confirmed against the approved scope.
verify: Run a test quote in one approved and one withheld state.
Pass when the form is selectable only in approved states.

generic.Defined scope/population: Charged rates by state, class and effective date for policies issued in the review period.
generic.In-scope period: The review period covering policy effective dates tested for rate conformity.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: State, class, effective date, charged premium and rating factors present on every row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recalculated premium compared to charged premium on every policy in the population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Conformity workbook retained with the filed rate schedule version used for comparison.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unauthorised deviations raised as compliance exceptions with a remediation owner.
generic.Test population: All policies tested for rate conformity in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Applied rate version equals the filed and approved version for the state and effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Unauthorised deviations escalated to the UW Operations Manager for remediation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No unexplained premium variance above tolerance without a documented deviation authority.
generic.Evidence location: Conformity workbook in Excel with filed schedules in SERFF and policies in the policy system.

steps.title: Extract charged rates from the policy administration system
sop: Extract charged rates by state, class and effective date for the period.
Check every row carries the rating factors applied.
Done when the charged rate extract is complete for the period.
verify: Reconcile extract policy counts to the policy system control report.
Pass when the extract covers the full in-force population for the period.

steps.title: Compare against the filed rate schedule
sop: Retrieve the filed rate schedule from SERFF for the state and period.
Compare the applied rate version against the filed version for each policy.
Done when every policy has its rate version compared.
verify: Re-check two policies against the SERFF filed schedule.
Pass when applied rate versions equal the filed versions in every check.

steps.title: Confirm all rating factors appear in the filed plan
sop: List the rating factors used including territory, class, experience mod and credits.
Confirm each appears in the filed rating plan for the state.
Done when every applied factor is confirmed filed or flagged.
verify: Trace two flagged factors to the filed rating plan.
Pass when no applied factor sits outside the filed rating plan.

steps.title: Isolate premium differences above tolerance
sop: Recalculate premium on the filed basis and compare against the charged premium.
Isolate policies differing beyond the rounding tolerance.
Done when the variance population is isolated and quantified.
verify: Recompute two variances by hand.
Pass when the isolated variances reproduce from the filed calculation.

steps.title: Test deviation authority on each difference
sop: Check whether a filed deviation exists for the state and class.
Where not, check for an authorised exception under the authority matrix.
Done when every variance has a deviation or authority position recorded.
verify: Trace two authorised exceptions to the authority matrix.
Pass when every variance carries a filed deviation or a valid approval.

steps.title: Raise unauthorised deviations as compliance exceptions
sop: Raise an exception for every variance with no deviation or authority.
Assign a remediation owner and target date to each exception.
Done when every unauthorised variance has a logged exception.
verify: Reconcile exceptions to the unauthorised variance list.
Pass when every unauthorised variance has a matching exception record.

steps.title: Record the conformity result and direct remediation
sop: Review the conformity result and the exception population.
Direct remediation such as endorsement, refund or rating correction.
Done when the conformity result is recorded with directed remediation.
verify: Check the conformity record for the management direction.
Pass when the recorded result shows directed remediation for every exception.

generic.Defined scope/population: All filed policy forms, endorsements and rate filings across every state and line of business.
generic.In-scope period: The review period since the last register sign-off.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Identifier, edition date, state, line, filing number, status and effective date per entry.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Register entries reconcile to open and closed filings shown in SERFF.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Register published with the reviewer name, review date and version number.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Entries with unresolved status logged with the owner and the follow-up action.
generic.Test population: All register entries and all SERFF filings for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Current register shows status, state, line and effective date on every entry.
generic.Exception handling path: Register discrepancies escalated to the UW Operations Manager for correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No open SERFF filing missing from the register.
generic.Evidence location: Filed forms register in SharePoint and Excel with source dispositions in SERFF.

steps.title: Reconcile the register against SERFF dispositions
sop: Export open and closed filings from SERFF for the review period.
Match each against the register and list unmatched filings.
Done when the reconciliation list of unmatched filings is produced.
verify: Count SERFF filings against register entries.
Pass when every SERFF filing matches a register entry or appears on the gap list.

steps.title: Add filings opened since the last review
sop: Create a register entry for each newly opened filing.
Populate identifier, edition date, state, line, filing number and status.
Done when every new filing has a complete register entry.
verify: Filter new entries for blank required fields.
Pass when no new entry is left with a blank required field.

steps.title: Update status transitions with dates
sop: Update entries for submitted, objected, approved, withdrawn or superseded status.
Record the date each transition occurred.
Done when every status change in the period is recorded with its date.
verify: Compare two status entries to the SERFF disposition history.
Pass when register status and dates match the portal history.

steps.title: Mark superseded editions clearly
sop: Mark retired form and rate editions as superseded on the register.
Record the superseding edition against each retired entry.
Done when every retired edition is marked and linked to its replacement.
verify: Search the register for retired editions without a superseded mark.
Pass when no retired edition remains presented as current.

steps.title: Confirm register accuracy with UW Operations
sop: Check the register against the forms actually deployed in the policy system.
Report any deployed form that the register does not show as approved.
Done when deployment and register positions are compared.
verify: Compare two deployed forms to their register entries.
Pass when every deployed form is shown as approved on the register.

steps.title: Sign off the register review
sop: Review the reconciliation, the gap list and the status updates.
Sign off the register with reviewer name and review date.
Done when the register carries a recorded sign-off.
verify: Open the register and read the sign-off block.
Pass when the register shows reviewer name, date and version.

steps.title: Publish the current register version
sop: Publish the signed register to SharePoint with its version number.
Withdraw the prior version from the working folder.
Done when only the current signed register is published.
verify: Search the library for prior register versions.
Pass when only the current signed version is retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: DOI bulletin feeds and legislative trackers for every state in which the company writes.
generic.In-scope period: The monitoring period covered by this review including nil returns.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each item carries a triage decision, reason, required action, deadline and owning function.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items triaged equal the items published in the monitored feeds for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Monitoring log entry retained with the reviewer name and the review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items triaged as not relevant recorded with the reason for the decision.
generic.Test population: All bulletins and legislative items published in the monitoring period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Logged monitoring entry for the period with a triage decision on each bulletin.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous relevance decisions escalated to the Underwriting Director / Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No relevant bulletin left without an assigned owner and a compliance deadline.
generic.Evidence location: Monitoring log in the GRC platform with source bulletins filed in SharePoint.

steps.title: Review DOI bulletin feeds for every writing state
sop: Review the bulletin feed and legislative tracker for each state where the company writes.
Capture every published item for the period into the monitoring log.
Done when all published items for the period are captured.
verify: Compare captured items to the source feed listing.
Pass when no published item for a writing state is missing from the log.

steps.title: Triage each item for underwriting relevance
sop: Decide relevant or not relevant for underwriting forms, rates or disclosures.
Record the reason for each triage decision.
Done when every captured item carries a triage decision and reason.
verify: Filter the log for items without a triage decision.
Pass when no captured item is left untriaged.

steps.title: Log the required action and deadline for relevant items
sop: Record the required action and the compliance deadline for each relevant item.
Assign the owning function for delivery.
Done when every relevant item has an action, deadline and owner.
verify: Filter relevant items for blank owner or deadline.
Pass when no relevant item is left without an owner and deadline.

steps.title: Raise filing or form-amendment requests
sop: Raise a filing or amendment request where a new or amended filing is required.
Link the request to the bulletin that triggered it.
Done when every filing-triggering item has a raised request.
verify: Trace two raised requests to their source bulletins.
Pass when every filing-triggering item has a linked request.

steps.title: Assess operational impact with UW Operations
sop: Assess the system, workflow and training impact of each relevant item.
Record the operational actions needed and their owners.
Done when operational impact is recorded for every relevant item.
verify: Check operational actions against the relevant item list.
Pass when every relevant item shows an assessed operational impact.

steps.title: Escalate ambiguous relevance decisions
sop: Review items where relevance to underwriting is unclear.
Decide the position and record the rationale.
Done when every escalated item carries a decided position.
verify: Check escalated items for a recorded decision.
Pass when no escalated item is left without a decision and rationale.

steps.title: Record the period monitoring as complete
sop: Record the period review as complete including nil returns for quiet states.
Add the reviewer name and the review date to the log entry.
Done when the period monitoring entry is closed with reviewer and date.
verify: Open the log entry and check the completion block.
Pass when the entry shows completion including nil returns with reviewer and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every question raised in the DOI objection letter or information request on the filing.
generic.In-scope period: The window from objection receipt to the regulator response deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Receipt date, deadline, question owner, drafted answer and reviewer recorded per question.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Answered questions equal the questions raised in the objection letter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Submitted response and exhibits retained with the SERFF submission receipt timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Questions that cannot be answered fully logged with the position taken and approval.
generic.Test population: All objection questions on the filing being responded to.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Submitted response carries a timestamp inside the regulator deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: Deadline risk escalated to the Underwriting Director / Manager for an extension request.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Internal review sign-off recorded before the response was submitted.
generic.Evidence location: SERFF filing record with drafts and exhibits held in SharePoint and Excel.

steps.title: Log the objection letter and deadline
sop: Record the objection receipt date and the regulator response deadline.
Set internal milestones working back from the deadline.
Done when receipt date, deadline and milestones are logged.
verify: Compare the logged deadline to the objection letter.
Pass when the logged deadline matches the letter and drives the milestones.

steps.title: Break the objection into individual questions
sop: Split the letter into discrete questions and number them.
Assign each to actuarial, product or underwriting for a drafted answer.
Done when every question is numbered and assigned.
verify: Count assigned questions against the letter.
Pass when every question in the letter has an assignment.

steps.title: Draft the underwriting answers
sop: Draft the answers to underwriting questions on appetite, forms and practice.
Cite the guideline or filing basis supporting each answer.
Done when every underwriting question has a drafted cited answer.
verify: Check each answer cites a guideline or filing basis.
Pass when no underwriting answer is submitted without a cited basis.

steps.title: Assemble the response with supporting exhibits
sop: Assemble rating exhibits, form comparisons and statutory references.
Check each exhibit is referenced from the answer it supports.
Done when the response and all exhibits are assembled.
verify: Trace two exhibits to the answers referencing them.
Pass when every exhibit is referenced by at least one answer.

steps.title: Obtain internal review sign-off
sop: Review the assembled response for accuracy and consistency with the filing.
Record the reviewer name and sign-off date before submission.
Done when the sign-off is recorded on the response.
verify: Check the response record for the sign-off entry.
Pass when the sign-off predates the submission timestamp.

steps.title: Submit the response through SERFF
sop: Submit the response and exhibits against the correct filing in SERFF.
Capture the submission receipt against the filing record.
Done when the submission receipt is captured.
verify: Compare the submission timestamp to the regulator deadline.
Pass when the submission timestamp falls inside the deadline.

steps.title: Update the filing tracker with the response
sop: Record the response submission date and the new expected response date.
Flag any launch or deployment dependent on the outcome.
Done when the tracker reflects the submitted response.
verify: Compare tracker entries to the SERFF filing record.
Pass when the tracker status matches the portal after submission.

generic.Defined scope/population: All target states for the rate or form filing with their filing type and lead time.
generic.In-scope period: The submission window required to meet each state prior-approval or file-and-use timeframe.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Filing type, lead time, TOI and sub-TOI codes and package components recorded per state.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Filings submitted equal the target states listed in the filing plan.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Filing package retained with the assigned filing number and submission timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: States deferred from the submission logged with the reason and revised date.
generic.Test population: All filings submitted for the rate or form change.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Submitted filing carries an assigned filing number and correct TOI and sub-TOI coding.
generic.Exception handling path: Checklist items that cannot be met escalated to the Underwriting Director / Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No submitted filing missing from the tracker with owner and expected response date.
generic.Evidence location: SERFF submission records with the filing package and tracker held in SharePoint.

steps.title: Confirm filing type and lead time per target state
sop: Determine prior approval, file-and-use or use-and-file for each target state.
Record the required lead time and back-plan the submission date.
Done when filing type and lead time are recorded for every state.
verify: Check two states against the current state filing requirements.
Pass when recorded filing types match the state requirements.

steps.title: Assemble the filing package
sop: Assemble form set, rate and rule pages, actuarial memorandum and comparisons.
Add the explanatory memorandum describing the change and its rationale.
Done when every package component is assembled for each state.
verify: Check the package contents against the component list.
Pass when no required package component is missing for any state.

steps.title: Run the state-specific filing checklist
sop: Run the state checklist for each target state and resolve every required item.
Log any item that cannot be resolved before submission.
Done when every checklist item is resolved or logged.
verify: Re-run the checklist on two states after resolution.
Pass when no required checklist item is left unresolved at submission.

steps.title: Confirm the underwriting position on the filed change
sop: Review the filed forms and rates against the intended underwriting position.
Confirm the filing supports the appetite and pricing plan.
Done when the underwriting confirmation is recorded on the filing.
verify: Check the filing record for the underwriting confirmation.
Pass when the filing shows a recorded underwriting confirmation before submission.

steps.title: Submit through SERFF with correct TOI coding
sop: Submit under the correct type-of-insurance and sub-TOI codes for each state.
Record the assigned filing number returned by the portal.
Done when every state submission has an assigned filing number.
verify: Compare submitted TOI codes to the product coding standard.
Pass when every submission carries correct TOI and sub-TOI coding.

steps.title: Enter the filings into the tracker
sop: Enter submission date, expected response date and internal owner per filing.
Link the tracker entry to the SERFF filing number.
Done when every submitted filing is entered in the tracker.
verify: Compare tracker entries to the SERFF submissions.
Pass when no submitted filing is missing from the tracker.

steps.title: Confirm deferred states and revised dates
sop: Record any target state deferred from this submission with the reason.
Set the revised submission date and the owner for each deferral.
Done when every deferred state has a reason and a revised date.
verify: Compare the deferral list to the original target state list.
Pass when every unsubmitted target state carries a logged deferral.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every filing currently open in SERFF across all states and lines of business.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period between tracker refreshes.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Portal status, disposition date, expected response date and internal owner per filing.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tracker open filings equal the open filings shown in SERFF.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Tracker refresh retained with the refresh date and the portal status captured.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Filings past the statutory review window logged with the chase date and response.
generic.Test population: All open filings in the tracker for the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Portal status for every open filing matches the internal tracker status.
generic.Exception handling path: Blocked launches escalated to the UW Operations Manager to re-baseline the plan.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No filing past the statutory review window without a logged regulator chase.
generic.Evidence location: Filing tracker in SharePoint and Excel with source status held in SERFF.

steps.title: Refresh open filing status from SERFF
sop: Read the current disposition and date for every open filing in SERFF.
Update the tracker with the portal status and date.
Done when every open filing carries a refreshed status.
verify: Compare tracker status to the portal for a sample of filings.
Pass when tracker status matches the portal for every sampled filing.

steps.title: Age each open filing against its expected response date
sop: Compute days open against the expected response date for each filing.
Highlight filings beyond the state statutory review window.
Done when ageing is computed for every open filing.
verify: Recompute ageing on two filings from the submission date.
Pass when the ageing view reproduces from the submission dates.

steps.title: Chase filings past the review window
sop: Contact the regulator on filings beyond the statutory review window.
Log the contact date and the response received.
Done when every overdue filing has a logged chase.
verify: Compare the chase log to the overdue filing list.
Pass when no overdue filing is left without a logged chase.

steps.title: Flag filings blocking a launch or deployment
sop: Identify filings that gate a product launch or form deployment.
Flag them on the tracker with the dependent implementation date.
Done when every blocking filing is flagged with its dependency.
verify: Compare flagged filings to the implementation plan.
Pass when every gated implementation traces to a flagged filing.

steps.title: Re-baseline dependent implementation plans
sop: Revise the implementation dates affected by delayed filings.
Communicate the revised dates to the affected underwriting teams.
Done when dependent plans are re-baselined and communicated.
verify: Check the revised plan against the flagged filing status.
Pass when no dependent plan retains a date the filing status cannot support.

steps.title: Report filing status into the governance pack
sop: Review the open filing status and ageing for the governance pack.
Highlight regulatory delay risk to the committee.
Done when the filing status section is included in the pack.
verify: Compare the pack figures to the tracker.
Pass when the reported filing counts reconcile to the tracker.

steps.title: Close out filings reaching disposition
sop: Move filings with a final disposition to closed on the tracker.
Trigger the archiving and register update for each closed filing.
Done when every disposed filing is closed and handed off.
verify: Compare closed tracker entries to SERFF dispositions.
Pass when every closed entry matches a final portal disposition.

generic.Defined scope/population: Approved form editions and rate or rule pages to be loaded across every affected state.
generic.In-scope period: The deployment window from approval to the mandatory use date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Form edition, state, effective date and retirement date recorded on each loaded item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items loaded equal the approved editions listed in the deployment change request.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Change reference, deployment date and tester name recorded in the change log.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: States excluded from the load logged with the pending filing reason.
generic.Test population: Test quotes run in each affected state before and after the effective date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Approved editions active with correct effective dates in every affected state.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed test quotes escalated to the Compliance Analyst before release is confirmed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No superseded form or rate version selectable on new business after the mandatory date.
generic.Evidence location: Policy administration system configuration with the change log held in SharePoint.

steps.title: Load approved form editions into the policy system library
sop: Load each approved form edition with its state and effective-date rules.
Confirm the loaded edition matches the approval evidence.
Done when every approved edition is loaded for its states.
verify: Compare the loaded editions to the approval evidence.
Pass when every loaded edition matches an approved filing record.

steps.title: Load approved rate and rule pages into the rating tool
sop: Load the approved rate and rule pages with the correct effective date.
Confirm pre-effective business still rates on the prior version.
Done when the rates are loaded with correct effective dating.
verify: Rate a pre-effective and post-effective risk in the rating tool.
Pass when each risk rates on the version correct for its effective date.

steps.title: Retire superseded form and rate versions
sop: Set the retirement date on superseded form and rate versions.
Confirm they cannot be selected on new business after the mandatory date.
Done when every superseded version carries a retirement date.
verify: Attempt to select a retired version on a post-date new business quote.
Pass when no superseded version is selectable after the mandatory date.

steps.title: Confirm the load matches the approved scope
sop: Compare the loaded states against the approved state list.
Confirm no state with a pending filing has been activated.
Done when the load scope is confirmed against the approvals.
verify: Check the active state list in the policy system.
Pass when active states equal the approved states with no extras.

steps.title: Run test quotes in each affected state
sop: Run a test quote before and after the effective date in each affected state.
Record the form and rate version selected on each test.
Done when test quotes are run and recorded for every affected state.
verify: Compare selected versions to the expected version per test date.
Pass when every test selects the correct version for its date.

steps.title: Record the change reference and tester in the change log
sop: Record the change reference, deployment date and tester name.
Attach the test quote evidence to the change log entry.
Done when the change log entry is complete with evidence.
verify: Open the change log entry and check all fields and evidence.
Pass when the entry records reference, date, tester and test evidence.

steps.title: Confirm release readiness with underwriting management
sop: Review the load scope, test results and retirement settings.
Confirm the release or direct correction before go-live.
Done when the release confirmation is recorded.
verify: Check the change record for the management confirmation.
Pass when the release shows a recorded management confirmation.

generic.Defined scope/population: All surplus lines transactions for the period with state of risk, premium, fees and taxable base.
generic.In-scope period: The surplus lines tax filing period being validated before submission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Broker licence number, diligent search evidence, taxable base and home state on every transaction.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Filing totals reconcile to the policy administration system control report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation workbook retained with the extract date and the state tax rates applied.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Transactions failing validation logged with the correction made before submission.
generic.Test population: All surplus lines transactions in the filing period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Recalculated tax and stamping fee agree to the filed amounts per state.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled differences escalated to the UW Operations Manager before submission.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No surplus lines transaction missing broker licence number or diligent search evidence.
generic.Evidence location: Validation workbook in Excel with source transactions in the policy administration system.

steps.title: Extract surplus lines transactions for the period
sop: Extract transactions with state of risk, gross premium, policy fees and taxable base.
Check for blank state of risk or taxable base values.
Done when the transaction extract is complete for the period.
verify: Compare the extract count to the policy system surplus lines report.
Pass when the extract covers every surplus lines transaction in the period.

steps.title: Confirm broker licence and diligent search evidence
sop: Confirm each transaction carries a valid surplus lines broker licence number.
Confirm diligent search or declinations evidence where the state requires it.
Done when licence and diligent search evidence are confirmed per transaction.
verify: Check evidence on a sample of transactions.
Pass when no transaction is missing licence number or required search evidence.

steps.title: Recalculate premium tax and stamping fee
sop: Apply the state premium tax and stamping fee rates to each taxable base.
Compare the recalculated amounts against the figures on the filing.
Done when tax and fee are recalculated for every transaction.
verify: Recompute two transactions by hand against the state rate.
Pass when recalculated tax and fee agree to the filed amounts.

steps.title: Confirm home-state allocation on multi-state risks
sop: Identify multi-state risks and read the recorded home state.
Confirm the allocation follows the home-state rule for the transaction.
Done when home-state allocation is confirmed on every multi-state risk.
verify: Re-check two multi-state allocations against the home-state rule.
Pass when every multi-state risk allocates to the correct home state.

steps.title: Reconcile filing totals to the control report
sop: Total premium, tax and fees on the filing and compare to the control report.
Document any difference and its cause.
Done when the reconciliation is complete and documented.
verify: Re-add the filing totals against the control report.
Pass when filing totals agree to the control report or the difference is explained.

steps.title: Correct failed validations before submission
sop: Correct transactions failing licence, evidence, tax or allocation validation.
Log each correction with the reason and the corrected value.
Done when every failed validation is corrected and logged.
verify: Re-run the validation set after correction.
Pass when the validation run returns no outstanding failures.

steps.title: Authorise the filing for submission
sop: Review the validation results, corrections and reconciliation.
Authorise submission or hold the filing pending further correction.
Done when the submission authorisation decision is recorded.
verify: Check the validation record for the authorisation entry.
Pass when the filing shows a recorded authorisation before submission.

generic.Defined scope/population: Sampled in-force policies across each state and line with their issued policy document sets.
generic.In-scope period: In-force policies issued up to the verification cut-off date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, state, form number, edition date and register comparison result per file.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Policies verified equal the planned sample across every state and line.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Verification record retained with the register version used for the comparison.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every mismatch logged with policy number, state, form number and remediation route.
generic.Test population: All sampled in-force policies verified against the approved form register.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Issued forms match the approved edition recorded in the filed forms register.
generic.Exception handling path: Withdrawn edition findings escalated to the Compliance Analyst for remediation routing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No in-force policy carrying a withdrawn or superseded form edition.
generic.Evidence location: Issued policy documents in OpenText with the register comparison workbook in Excel.

steps.title: Sample in-force policies across state and line
sop: Draw a sample of in-force policies covering each state and line of business.
Record the sample basis and the cut-off date.
Done when the sample is drawn with state and line coverage.
verify: Check sample coverage against the active state and line list.
Pass when every active state and line is represented in the sample.

steps.title: Open the issued policy document set
sop: Retrieve the issued policy document set for each sampled policy from OpenText.
List every form number and edition date attached to the policy.
Done when the form list is captured for every sampled policy.
verify: Compare the captured form list to the policy document.
Pass when the captured list matches the issued document set.

steps.title: Compare forms against the approved register entry
sop: Compare each form number and edition date to the register entry for that state.
Record match or mismatch per form on each policy.
Done when every form on every sampled policy has a comparison result.
verify: Re-check two policies against the register.
Pass when the recorded results reproduce from the register entries.

steps.title: Confirm mandatory state endorsements are attached
sop: List the mandatory endorsements and notices for each state and line.
Confirm each is attached to the issued policy.
Done when mandatory attachment is confirmed per sampled policy.
verify: Check the mandatory list against two issued policies.
Pass when no sampled policy is missing a mandatory endorsement or notice.

steps.title: Test for withdrawn or superseded editions
sop: Identify policies issued after a mandatory use date carrying a retired edition.
Record each occurrence with the issue date and the retired edition.
Done when every retired-edition occurrence is identified.
verify: Compare issue dates to the mandatory use dates on the register.
Pass when every retired-edition case is captured with its issue date.

steps.title: Log mismatches with a remediation route
sop: Log each mismatch with policy number, state and form number.
Assign the remediation route as endorsement, reissue or notice.
Done when every mismatch carries a logged remediation route.
verify: Reconcile logged mismatches to the comparison results.
Pass when every recorded mismatch has a remediation route and owner.

steps.title: Confirm the verification result and remediation plan
sop: Review the verification result and the mismatch population.
Confirm the remediation plan and the dates for each route.
Done when the verification result and plan are recorded.
verify: Check the verification record for the confirmation and dates.
Pass when the recorded result shows a confirmed remediation plan.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every underwriter with QA defects, audit findings or scorecard variance in the last two cycles.
generic.In-scope period: The last two completed QA cycles and the current audit reporting period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Defect category, competency mapping and gap rating populated per underwriter.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Underwriters profiled equal the active underwriter roster for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Gap assessment saved with the cycle dates and the competency framework version used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Gaps attributed to workload or system issues logged with the alternative remedy.
generic.Test population: All recurring defect categories mapped in the assessment period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Defect categories mapped to competency framework areas with no unmapped category.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed gap attributions referred to the Underwriting Director / Manager for decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Documented gap profile per underwriter and a team-level competency heat map.
generic.Evidence location: Gap assessment in SharePoint with defect data in the GRC platform and views in Power BI.

steps.title: Pull QA defect rates by category per underwriter
sop: Extract defect rates by category per underwriter for the last two cycles.
Check every active underwriter appears even where the rate is zero.
Done when defect rates by category are extracted for all underwriters.
verify: Compare the extract roster to the active underwriter list.
Pass when every active underwriter appears in the extract.

steps.title: Overlay audit findings and scorecard variance
sop: Join audit findings and scorecard variances to each underwriter profile.
Separate knowledge gaps from workload and system-driven issues.
Done when each issue is attributed to knowledge, workload or system.
verify: Re-test two attributions against the underlying evidence.
Pass when each attribution is supported by the cited evidence.

steps.title: Map recurring defect categories to competencies
sop: Map each recurring defect category to the competency it implicates.
Flag categories with no matching competency for framework review.
Done when every recurring category carries a competency mapping.
verify: Check mappings against the competency framework version.
Pass when no recurring defect category is left unmapped.

steps.title: Produce the per-underwriter gap profile
sop: Build a gap profile per underwriter listing competencies and severity.
Include workload or system factors as context rather than gaps.
Done when every underwriter has a gap profile.
verify: Filter the roster for underwriters without a profile.
Pass when no active underwriter is left without a gap profile.

steps.title: Build the team-level competency heat map
sop: Aggregate individual gaps into a team-level heat map by competency.
Rank the weakest competencies across the team.
Done when the heat map is produced and ranked.
verify: Recompute one heat map cell from the individual profiles.
Pass when the heat map reproduces from the individual gap profiles.

steps.title: Confirm operational context with UW Operations
sop: Confirm workload, staffing and system change context for the flagged gaps.
Raise gaps better solved by process or tooling than by training.
Done when operational context is recorded against the flagged gaps.
verify: Check the context notes against the flagged gaps.
Pass when every workload or system attributed gap has a stated remedy.

steps.title: Feed prioritised gaps into the training backlog
sop: Prioritise the gaps and name the target audience for each.
Add them to the training programme design backlog in SharePoint.
Done when every prioritised gap is on the backlog with an audience.
verify: Compare the backlog to the prioritised gap list.
Pass when every prioritised gap appears on the backlog with an audience.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every underwriter proposed for an increase in binding authority in the assessment round.
generic.In-scope period: The assessment round covering the candidate performance history reviewed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Evidence pack, assessment score, decision, approver name and effective date per candidate.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assessments completed equal the candidates nominated for progression.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assessment record retained with the authority matrix version and the decision date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deferred candidates logged with the development actions and the review date.
generic.Test population: All candidates assessed for authority progression in the round.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: System authority level matches the approved authority matrix entry and effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Contested outcomes escalated to the Chief Underwriting Officer for final decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No authority increase applied without a completed and approved assessment record.
generic.Evidence location: Assessment records in SharePoint with authority profiles in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Assemble the candidate evidence pack
sop: Collect QA scores, audit findings, referral quality, loss ratio and training completion.
Confirm the evidence covers the full period at the current authority level.
Done when a complete evidence pack exists for every candidate.
verify: Check pack components against the required evidence list.
Pass when no candidate pack is missing a required component.

steps.title: Run the technical assessment
sop: Assess coverage, rating and appetite knowledge required at the target authority level.
Record the score against the pass standard for the level.
Done when every candidate has a recorded technical assessment score.
verify: Compare scores against the published pass standard.
Pass when every candidate score is recorded against the correct standard.

steps.title: Review referral decision quality
sop: Review referral decisions the candidate made at the current level.
Assess the judgement shown rather than the eventual outcome.
Done when referral judgement is assessed for every candidate.
verify: Check the assessment cites specific referral decisions.
Pass when every judgement assessment cites reviewed referral files.

steps.title: Record the progression decision
sop: Decide grant, defer or partial for each candidate.
Record the approver name and the effective date of any change.
Done when every candidate has a recorded decision and date.
verify: Filter the candidate list for blank decisions.
Pass when no candidate is left without a recorded decision.

steps.title: Obtain CUO approval for authority increases
sop: Review the evidence and the assessment result for each proposed increase.
Approve or refuse and record the decision with the reason.
Done when every proposed increase carries a CUO decision.
verify: Check the assessment record for the CUO approval entry.
Pass when no authority increase proceeds without a recorded CUO approval.

steps.title: Update the authority matrix
sop: Update the authority matrix entry for each approved candidate.
Record the effective date and the version of the matrix.
Done when the matrix reflects every approved change.
verify: Compare matrix entries to the approved decisions.
Pass when every matrix entry matches an approved assessment record.

steps.title: Update the authority profile in the underwriting workstation
sop: Set the system authority profile to the approved level and effective date.
Confirm referral triggers adjust to the new authority level.
Done when the system profile matches the approved matrix entry.
verify: Test a risk at the new authority boundary in the workstation.
Pass when the system enforces the approved authority level and triggers.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every attendee assigned to the training event whose knowledge is being assessed.
generic.In-scope period: The assessment window following delivery of the training event.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Attendee score, pass mark, attempt number and retake date populated in the LMS.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assessment records equal the attendance records for the training event.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assessment results retained against the training event with the question set version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Attendees below the pass mark logged with the remedial action and retake date.
generic.Test population: All attendees of the training event in the assessment window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Score recorded for every attendee against the published pass mark.
generic.Exception handling path: Repeated failures escalated to the Underwriting Director / Manager for coaching.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No attendee below the pass mark without a scheduled retake or remedial action.
generic.Evidence location: Learning management system records with analysis held in Excel on the training folder.

steps.title: Publish the assessment in the LMS
sop: Publish the assessment against the training event with the defined pass mark.
Assign it to the attendee list with the completion window.
Done when the assessment is live and assigned to every attendee.
verify: Compare the assignment list to the attendance record.
Pass when every attendee is assigned the assessment.

steps.title: Set application-based questions
sop: Write questions that require rating a risk, selecting a form or deciding a referral.
Remove questions answerable by recall of the slide text alone.
Done when the question set tests application rather than recall.
verify: Review the question set against the learning objectives.
Pass when every objective is tested by at least one application question.

steps.title: Record scores per attendee
sop: Record each attendee score against the training event in the LMS.
Chase attendees who have not completed within the window.
Done when every attendee has a recorded score or a logged chase.
verify: Compare score records to the attendee list.
Pass when no attendee is left without a score or a logged chase.

steps.title: Identify the weakest question areas
sop: Compute the cohort pass rate per question in Excel.
List the questions with the lowest pass rate.
Done when the weakest question areas are identified.
verify: Recompute two question pass rates from the raw responses.
Pass when the computed pass rates reproduce from the responses.

steps.title: Schedule remedial coaching and retakes
sop: Schedule coaching for every attendee below the pass mark.
Record the retake date against each attendee in the LMS.
Done when every below-standard attendee has coaching and a retake date.
verify: Filter below-standard attendees for missing retake dates.
Pass when no attendee below the pass mark lacks a scheduled retake.

steps.title: Escalate repeated failures
sop: Review attendees failing the retake or missing the coaching.
Direct further action such as supervision or authority review.
Done when every repeated failure has a directed action.
verify: Check the escalation list for recorded directions.
Pass when no repeated failure is left without a management direction.

steps.title: Feed weak areas into the next training iteration
sop: Pass the weakest question areas to the training content owner.
Record the change request against the module in the LMS.
Done when every weak area is fed back with a logged change request.
verify: Compare change requests to the weakest question list.
Pass when every weak area produces a logged content change request.

generic.Defined scope/population: Anonymised real cases covering the defect categories with the highest QA failure rate.
generic.In-scope period: The workshop delivery window following the latest QA cycle results.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Attendance, case list, participant decisions and agreed treatment recorded per case.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Attendance records equal the invited participant list for the workshop.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Guidance note and case pack retained with the workshop date and guideline version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cases where the guideline was ambiguous logged for guideline amendment.
generic.Test population: All cases discussed in the workshop and all participants attending.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Attendance recorded against every participant training record.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved case treatments referred to the Underwriting Director / Manager for a ruling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Circulated note documents the agreed treatment for every case discussed.
generic.Evidence location: Learning management system attendance with the case pack and note in SharePoint.

steps.title: Select cases from the highest-failure defect categories
sop: Identify the defect categories with the highest QA failure rate.
Select and anonymise real cases covering those categories.
Done when the anonymised case pack covers the target categories.
verify: Compare the case pack to the top defect categories.
Pass when every top defect category is represented in the case pack.

steps.title: Have participants decide each case independently
sop: Ask participants to price, form and decide each case before discussion.
Collect the individual decisions before any group debate begins.
Done when every participant has submitted independent decisions.
verify: Count submitted decisions against attendance.
Pass when every attendee submitted a decision for every case.

steps.title: Compare the decision spread and surface outlier reasoning
sop: Display the spread of decisions per case.
Ask the outliers to explain their reasoning to the group.
Done when the spread and outlier reasoning are captured for every case.
verify: Check the workshop record for the spread and reasoning notes.
Pass when every case shows a captured spread and outlier rationale.

steps.title: Agree the correct treatment against the guideline
sop: Work each case against the current guideline and agree the correct treatment.
Record where the guideline itself was ambiguous.
Done when every case has an agreed treatment recorded.
verify: Check the agreed treatments cite the guideline clause.
Pass when every agreed treatment cites the guideline it relies on.

steps.title: Log guideline ambiguities for amendment
sop: List the clauses found ambiguous during the workshop.
Raise each for guideline amendment with the ambiguity described.
Done when every ambiguity is logged for amendment.
verify: Compare the ambiguity log to the workshop notes.
Pass when every noted ambiguity is logged for guideline review.

steps.title: Capture attendance in the LMS
sop: Record attendance against each participant training record in the LMS.
Chase any invited participant who did not attend.
Done when attendance is recorded for every participant.
verify: Compare LMS attendance to the invited participant list.
Pass when every attendee has a recorded training entry.

steps.title: Circulate the agreed case treatments as a guidance note
sop: Review and approve the guidance note covering every case treatment.
Circulate it to the wider underwriting team and post it to the library.
Done when the approved note is circulated and published.
verify: Open the published note and check every case is covered.
Pass when the circulated note documents the treatment for every case.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every underwriter and assistant who will write the new product or expanded coverage.
generic.In-scope period: The window from training build to the product effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Attendance, session date, product version and states covered recorded per session.
