generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Attendance equals the list of underwriters authorised to write the product.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Deck and worked example published with the product version and publication date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Non-attendees logged with the catch-up session date before they may write the line.
generic.Test population: All underwriters and assistants authorised to write the new product.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Attendance logged for every underwriter authorised to write the new product.
generic.Exception handling path: Non-attendance before the effective date escalated to the Underwriting Director / Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Training deck and worked example published before the product effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Learning management system attendance with the deck in the SharePoint guidance library.

steps.title: Build the session around the product artefacts
sop: Build the session on the appetite statement, rating plan, form set and referral triggers.
Confirm each artefact is the approved current version.
Done when the session content is built from approved artefacts.
verify: Compare the cited artefact versions to the approved versions.
Pass when the session uses only current approved artefacts.

steps.title: Prepare a live worked example in the underwriting workstation
sop: Prepare an end-to-end example covering quote, rate, form selection and bind.
Test the example runs cleanly in the workstation before delivery.
Done when the worked example runs end to end without error.
verify: Re-run the worked example in the workstation.
Pass when the example completes quote to bind as documented.

steps.title: Cover approved states and variations
sop: List the states in which the product is approved and any variations or exclusions.
Include the states where the product must not be written.
Done when state coverage and variations are documented in the session.
verify: Compare the stated states to the approved filing record.
Pass when the session state list matches the approved filings.

steps.title: Build the attendee list from the authorised writers
sop: List every underwriter and assistant who will write the line.
Validate the list against the authority and roster records.
Done when the attendee list covers every authorised writer.
verify: Compare the list to the product authorisation records.
Pass when no authorised writer is missing from the attendee list.

steps.title: Deliver the training before the product effective date
sop: Deliver the session to the full attendee list before the effective date.
Schedule a catch-up session for anyone unable to attend.
Done when delivery is complete and catch-ups are scheduled.
verify: Compare session dates to the product effective date.
Pass when all delivery or scheduled catch-up precedes the effective date.

steps.title: Log attendance in the LMS
sop: Record attendance against each participant training record.
Flag non-attendees so they cannot be released to write the line.
Done when attendance and non-attendance are both recorded.
verify: Compare LMS attendance to the authorised writer list.
Pass when every authorised writer shows attendance or a flagged catch-up.

steps.title: Publish the deck and worked example to the guidance library
sop: Post the deck and worked example to the guidance library in SharePoint.
Link them from the product guidance page for later retrieval.
Done when both are published and linked before the effective date.
verify: Search the library for the product training materials.
Pass when the deck and worked example are retrievable before the effective date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The prioritised competency gaps translated into technical training modules for underwriters.
generic.In-scope period: The training programme cycle the modules will be delivered in.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Objectives, duration, delivery mode, assessment method, owner and review date per module.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Modules published equal the prioritised gaps carried onto the design backlog.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Module records retained in the LMS with the content version and publication date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Gaps not addressed this cycle logged with the reason and the deferred date.
generic.Test population: All modules published in the technical training catalogue for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Each module published with target audience, objectives and assessment method.
generic.Exception handling path: Vendor content failing the guideline check rejected and escalated for replacement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No module in the catalogue without a named content owner and a review date.
generic.Evidence location: Learning management system module records with design notes held in SharePoint.

steps.title: Translate prioritised gaps into a module list
sop: Convert the prioritised competency gaps into modules covering rating, coverage and forms.
Add risk analysis modules where the gap assessment identifies them.
Done when every prioritised gap maps to at least one module.
verify: Compare the module list to the prioritised gap backlog.
Pass when no prioritised gap is left without a mapped module.

steps.title: Decide build versus buy per module
sop: Assess each module for internal build or vendor purchase.
Record the decision and the rationale for each module.
Done when every module has a build or buy decision recorded.
verify: Check the decisions against cost, timing and content fit.
Pass when every module decision carries a documented rationale.

steps.title: Check vendor content against company guidelines and forms
sop: Review purchased content against the company guidelines, forms and rating practice.
Reject or require adaptation where the content conflicts.
Done when every vendor module is checked and dispositioned.
verify: Compare two vendor modules to the current guideline.
Pass when no vendor module teaches practice conflicting with the guideline.

steps.title: Define objectives, duration, mode and assessment
sop: Define learning objectives, duration, delivery mode and assessment per module.
Confirm the assessment method tests the stated objectives.
Done when all four attributes are defined for every module.
verify: Check each assessment method against its objectives.
Pass when every objective is covered by the module assessment.

steps.title: Load the modules into the LMS
sop: Load each module with its target audience and required completion window.
Confirm the audience mapping resolves to real underwriter groups.
Done when every module is loaded with audience and completion window.
verify: Check the audience assignment on two modules.
Pass when every module resolves to a valid target audience.

steps.title: Assign a content owner and review date per module
sop: Name a content owner for each module and confirm acceptance.
Set the content review date so material does not drift from guidelines.
Done when every module carries an owner and a review date.
verify: Filter the catalogue for modules without owner or review date.
Pass when no catalogue module is left without an owner and review date.

steps.title: Publish the technical training catalogue
sop: Publish the catalogue with objectives, audience and assessment per module.
Notify underwriting managers of the available modules and windows.
Done when the catalogue is published and communicated.
verify: Open the published catalogue and check the entry fields.
Pass when every published module shows audience, objectives and assessment.

generic.Defined scope/population: Changes between the current underwriting guideline and appetite and the prior refresher version.
generic.In-scope period: The period since the previous guideline and appetite refresher module was published.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Module cites guideline version, appetite version, approver name and review date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Changes covered in the module equal the changes shown by the guideline diff.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Module published in the LMS with content version and approval date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Changes deliberately excluded from the module logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: All guideline and appetite changes identified in the diff.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Module references the current approved guideline and appetite version numbers.
generic.Exception handling path: Content disputes resolved by the Underwriting Director / Manager before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Module published with approver name and content review date recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Learning management system module record with source guidelines in SharePoint.

steps.title: Diff the current guideline and appetite against the prior version
sop: Compare the current guideline and appetite statement against the prior refresher version.
List every substantive change with its clause reference.
Done when the change list is complete with clause references.
verify: Re-check two listed changes against the published documents.
Pass when the change list reproduces from the document comparison.

steps.title: Build the module around what changed
sop: Cover new target classes, newly prohibited classes and revised referral triggers.
Include authority changes and how they affect day-to-day binding.
Done when every listed change is covered in the module.
verify: Compare module content to the change list.
Pass when no listed change is absent from the module.

steps.title: Include the no-write list and the exception route
sop: Include the current no-write list and how it is applied at submission.
Explain the exception route requiring CUO approval.
Done when the no-write list and exception route are covered.
verify: Compare the module no-write list to the published appetite.
Pass when the module no-write list matches the current appetite statement.

steps.title: Add scenario questions on the changed rules
sop: Write scenario questions that force a decision under the changed rules.
Remove questions that only test recall of the guideline text.
Done when each major change has a scenario question.
verify: Map the questions to the change list.
Pass when every major change is tested by at least one scenario.

steps.title: Cite the current guideline and appetite versions
sop: Record the guideline and appetite version numbers in the module front matter.
Confirm both versions are the current approved versions.
Done when the module cites the current approved versions.
verify: Compare the cited versions to the published documents.
Pass when the module cites the current approved version numbers.

steps.title: Obtain approval of the module content
sop: Review the module for accuracy against the guideline and appetite.
Approve the content and record the approver name and date.
Done when the module carries a recorded approval.
verify: Open the module record and read the approval block.
Pass when the module shows approver name and approval date.

steps.title: Publish the module to the LMS with a review date
sop: Publish the approved module with its content version to the LMS.
Set the content review date and the assigned audience.
Done when the module is published with a review date and audience.
verify: Check the published module properties in the LMS.
Pass when the module shows version, approver, audience and review date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Specialty and primary lines carrying succession or single-point-of-knowledge risk.
generic.In-scope period: The rotation programme year covering scheduling through completion.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Host, objectives, dates, binding limits and supervision arrangement per rotation.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rotations completed equal the rotations scheduled in the programme.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rotation record retained with the debrief note and competency evidence dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rotations cancelled or curtailed logged with the reason and the reschedule date.
generic.Test population: All scheduled rotations in the programme year.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Rotation schedule shows host, objectives, dates and supervision arrangement.
generic.Exception handling path: Coverage risk on the home desk escalated to the Underwriting Director / Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No completed rotation missing its debrief and competency record.
generic.Evidence location: Rotation records in SharePoint with training entries in the learning management system.

steps.title: Identify lines with succession or knowledge concentration risk
sop: Identify specialty and primary lines dependent on a single individual.
Rank the lines by the impact of losing that knowledge.
Done when the at-risk line list is produced and ranked.
verify: Compare the list to the succession plan critical roles.
Pass when every single-point line in the succession plan appears.

steps.title: Pair rotating underwriters with host senior underwriters
sop: Pair each rotating underwriter with a host senior underwriter.
Set the learning objectives and the duration for each rotation.
Done when every rotation has a host, objectives and duration.
verify: Filter rotations for missing host or objectives.
Pass when no rotation is left without a host and stated objectives.

steps.title: Set binding limits and supervision in the workstation
sop: Define what the rotating underwriter may bind during the rotation.
Set the supervision and referral arrangement in the underwriting workstation.
Done when binding limits and supervision are configured.
verify: Test a risk at the rotation binding boundary in the workstation.
Pass when the system enforces the rotation binding limit and referral.

steps.title: Schedule rotations to preserve home desk coverage
sop: Schedule the rotations so the home desk retains coverage throughout.
Confirm cover arrangements with the affected managers.
Done when every rotation is scheduled with confirmed home cover.
verify: Check the schedule against desk coverage for each period.
Pass when no period leaves a desk without confirmed coverage.

steps.title: Run the rotation and monitor supervision
sop: Supervise the rotating underwriter against the agreed limits.
Raise any risk bound outside the rotation arrangement immediately.
Done when the rotation runs to its end date under supervision.
verify: Review binds made during the rotation against the limits.
Pass when no rotation bind exceeded the agreed limit without approval.

steps.title: Debrief at the end of each rotation
sop: Hold a debrief covering objectives met and gaps remaining.
Record the competencies evidenced during the rotation.
Done when every completed rotation has a recorded debrief.
verify: Filter completed rotations for missing debriefs.
Pass when no completed rotation is left without a debrief record.

steps.title: Record completion on the training record
sop: Record rotation completion and evidenced competencies in the LMS.
Link the debrief note to the individual training record.
Done when completion and competencies are recorded in the LMS.
verify: Compare LMS entries to the completed rotation list.
Pass when every completed rotation has an LMS competency record.

generic.Defined scope/population: All licensed underwriters with a state licence carrying continuing education obligations.
generic.In-scope period: The current CE reporting period for each licensed individual.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Licence number, state, reporting period end, hours completed and credit type per individual.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Internal CE hours reconcile to the state or NIPR transcript per individual.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Provider certificates retained against each completion with the completion date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Projected shortfalls logged with the assigned courses and the completion date.
generic.Test population: All licensed underwriters in the current CE reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Completed CE hours with certificates recorded against each licensed underwriter.
generic.Exception handling path: Individuals still short inside 60 days escalated to the Underwriting Director / Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No licensed underwriter short of the state CE requirement inside the deadline window.
generic.Evidence location: Learning management system CE records with the roster tracked in Excel and SharePoint.

steps.title: Maintain the licensed underwriter roster
sop: Record each licensed underwriter with state licence, number and reporting period end.
Add joiners and remove leavers since the last review.
Done when the roster reflects the current licensed population.
verify: Compare the roster to the HR and licensing records.
Pass when every currently licensed underwriter appears on the roster.

steps.title: Record completed CE hours and certificates
sop: Record completed hours per individual with the credit type.
Attach the provider certificate to each completion in the LMS.
Done when every completion is recorded with its certificate.
verify: Open certificates on a sample of completions.
Pass when every recorded completion carries a matching certificate.

steps.title: Compare hours against each state requirement
sop: Compare hours completed against the requirement for each licensed state.
Check ethics and line-specific sub-requirements separately.
Done when every individual is measured against their state requirements.
verify: Re-check two individuals against the state requirement tables.
Pass when the measured position matches the state requirement.

steps.title: Flag projected shortfalls with 60 days to deadline
sop: Project completions against the reporting deadline for each individual.
Flag anyone projected short with more than 60 days remaining.
Done when every projected shortfall is flagged.
verify: Recompute the projection for two flagged individuals.
Pass when the flags reproduce from hours completed and time remaining.

steps.title: Assign the courses needed to close shortfalls
sop: Assign the specific courses required to close each shortfall.
Set completion dates that precede the reporting deadline.
Done when every shortfall has assigned courses and dates.
verify: Check assigned courses satisfy the outstanding requirement.
Pass when the assigned courses close the measured shortfall in time.

steps.title: Reconcile against the state or NIPR transcript
sop: Compare the internal record against the state or NIPR CE transcript.
Investigate and resolve any difference before the deadline.
Done when the reconciliation is complete for every individual.
verify: Re-check two reconciliations against the transcript.
Pass when internal hours agree to the transcript or differences are explained.

steps.title: Escalate individuals still short near the deadline
sop: Review individuals still short inside the deadline window.
Direct the recovery action and confirm licence risk is managed.
Done when every remaining shortfall has a directed action.
verify: Check the escalation list for recorded directions.
Pass when no licensed underwriter is left short without a directed action.

generic.Defined scope/population: Critical underwriting roles including CUO, line leads, top-authority and specialty single-point roles.
generic.In-scope period: The succession review period covering the refreshed readiness ratings.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Successor names, readiness rating, readiness gap and development action per role.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Roles covered in the plan equal the critical role list for underwriting.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Refreshed plan stored with the review date and the plan version number.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Roles with no identified successor logged with the mitigation and review date.
generic.Test population: All critical underwriting roles in the succession plan.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Current plan shows named successors and readiness ratings for every critical role.
generic.Exception handling path: Roles without a successor escalated to the Chief Underwriting Officer for mitigation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No critical underwriting role without an identified successor.
generic.Evidence location: Restricted leadership library in SharePoint with development actions tracked in the LMS.

steps.title: List the critical underwriting roles
sop: List CUO, line leads, highest-authority underwriters and specialty single-point roles.
Confirm the list against the current organisation structure.
Done when the critical role list is complete and current.
verify: Compare the list to the underwriting organisation record.
Pass when every critical role in the structure appears on the list.

steps.title: Name ready-now and ready-later successors
sop: Name ready-now and ready-later successors for each critical role.
State the readiness gap for each named successor.
Done when every role has named successors with stated gaps.
verify: Filter the plan for roles without a named successor.
Pass when no critical role is left without an identified successor.

steps.title: Link each readiness gap to a development action
sop: Link each gap to a rotation, authority progression or targeted training action.
Load the action into the LMS or the rotation programme.
Done when every readiness gap has a linked development action.
verify: Compare development actions to the readiness gaps.
Pass when every stated gap has a corresponding development action.

steps.title: Review readiness ratings with the CUO
sop: Review the successors and readiness ratings for each critical role.
Adjust ratings where the evidence does not support them.
Done when every readiness rating is reviewed and confirmed.
verify: Check the plan for the CUO review entry.
Pass when the plan shows a dated CUO review of the ratings.

steps.title: Mitigate roles with no viable successor
sop: Identify roles with no ready-now or ready-later successor.
Agree the mitigation such as external hire or knowledge transfer.
Done when every uncovered role has an agreed mitigation.
verify: Check uncovered roles for a recorded mitigation.
Pass when no uncovered critical role is left without a mitigation.

steps.title: Refresh the plan version and review date
sop: Increment the plan version and record the review date.
Record the participants in the review on the front sheet.
Done when the version and review metadata are recorded.
verify: Open the refreshed plan and read the front sheet.
Pass when the plan shows version, review date and reviewers.

steps.title: Store the plan in the restricted leadership library
sop: Store the refreshed plan in the restricted-access leadership library.
Confirm access is limited to the approved leadership and HR list.
Done when the plan is stored with restricted access confirmed.
verify: Review the effective permissions on the stored plan.
Pass when access is limited to the approved leadership list only.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every competency in the underwriting framework across all authority tiers and product lines.
generic.In-scope period: The framework review period since the last published version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Competency definition, proficiency level, authority tier mapping and owner per entry.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Authority tiers in the matrix all map to defined competencies in the framework.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published framework retained with version number, owner and next review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Competencies retired logged with the reason and the replacement where applicable.
generic.Test population: All framework competencies and all authority tiers in the matrix.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Current framework version shows owner, approval date and next review date.
generic.Exception handling path: Mapping gaps escalated to the Underwriting Director / Manager before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No authority tier in the matrix without defined competencies at the required proficiency.
generic.Evidence location: Framework document in SharePoint with proficiency mapping held in Excel and the LMS.

steps.title: Review competency definitions against current practice
sop: Review each competency against current products, systems and guidelines.
Mark obsolete competencies for retirement with the reason.
Done when every competency is confirmed current or marked obsolete.
verify: Check two competencies against the current guideline and systems.
Pass when no retained competency describes a retired practice.

steps.title: Express competencies at proficiency levels tied to authority
sop: Define proficiency levels for each competency aligned to authority tiers.
Make the progression criteria objective and observable.
Done when every competency carries proficiency levels by tier.
verify: Test two competencies against the authority tier definitions.
Pass when each proficiency level maps cleanly to an authority tier.

steps.title: Add competencies for new products, tools and obligations
sop: Add competencies for newly introduced products and rating tools.
Add competencies for new regulatory obligations affecting underwriting.
Done when every recent change is reflected in the framework.
verify: Compare the framework to the product and regulatory change log.
Pass when every material change since the last version is covered.

steps.title: Map the framework onto the authority matrix
sop: Map each authority tier to the competencies required at that tier.
List any tier left without defined competencies.
Done when every authority tier carries a competency mapping.
verify: Filter the matrix for tiers without mapped competencies.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Overdue actions logged with the escalation and the revised date.
generic.Test population: All open and closed actions in the governance action register.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No open action without a named individual owner and a due date.
generic.Exception handling path: Overdue actions escalated to the Underwriting Director / Manager before each committee.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every minuted decision has a corresponding action register entry.
generic.Evidence location: Governance action register in the GRC platform with minutes filed in SharePoint.

steps.title: Extract decisions and actions from the minutes
sop: Read the signed minutes and extract every decision and action.
Log each one in the governance action register.
Done when every minuted decision and action is logged.
verify: Compare register entries to the minutes item by item.
Pass when every minuted decision has a register entry.

steps.title: Assign a named owner and due date to each action
sop: Assign an individual owner rather than a team or function.
Set a due date agreed with the owner.
Done when every action has a named owner and due date.
verify: Filter the register for actions without owner or date.
Pass when no open action is left without a named owner and due date.

steps.title: Age open actions before each committee
sop: Age every open action against its due date.
Produce the overdue list ahead of each committee meeting.
Done when the ageing and overdue list are produced.
verify: Recompute ageing on two actions from the due date.
Pass when the ageing view reproduces from the recorded due dates.

steps.title: Require closure evidence before marking complete
sop: Require an updated guideline, system change reference or issued report as evidence.
Reject closure requests without evidence attached.
Done when every closure carries attached evidence.
verify: Open evidence on a sample of closed actions.
Pass when no action is marked complete without readable evidence.

steps.title: Escalate overdue actions
sop: Escalate every overdue action with its ageing and the delay reason.
Record the escalation date on the action.
Done when every overdue action is escalated and logged.
verify: Compare the escalation log to the overdue list.
Pass when no overdue action is left unescalated.

steps.title: Direct recovery on escalated actions
sop: Review each escalated action and the reason for the delay.
Direct the recovery step and revise the date where justified.
Done when every escalated action has a directed recovery step.
verify: Check escalated actions for recorded directions.
Pass when no escalated action is left without a management direction.

steps.title: Report action status into the next committee pack
sop: Report action status and overdue items as a standing pack item.
Reconcile the reported counts to the action register.
Done when the action status section is included in the pack.
verify: Compare the pack action counts to the register.
Pass when the reported action status reconciles to the register.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every governance decision requiring a change to underwriting guideline clauses.
generic.In-scope period: The period from committee decision to the guideline effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each change records the decision reference, clause, approver and effective date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Guideline changes made equal the guideline-affecting decisions in the minutes.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: New guideline version published with a change history entry per decision.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Decisions deferred from this guideline release logged with the reason and date.
generic.Test population: All guideline changes made from committee decisions in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Each guideline change records the decision reference, approver and effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous decisions referred back to the committee before drafting the clause.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Configured referral triggers match the current approved guideline version.
generic.Evidence location: Guidance library in SharePoint with trigger configuration in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Translate each decision into a guideline clause change
sop: Identify the clause affected by each decision on appetite, referral, authority or documentation.
Write the intended clause change for each decision.
Done when every guideline-affecting decision has a drafted clause change.
verify: Compare drafted changes to the minuted decisions.
Pass when every guideline-affecting decision has a drafted clause change.

steps.title: Record decision reference and effective date in the change history
sop: Record the governance decision reference against each change.
Set the effective date for each clause change.
Done when the change history records reference and effective date.
verify: Open the change history table and check each entry.
Pass when every change entry shows a decision reference and effective date.

steps.title: Test the drafted clauses against underwriting practice
sop: Test each drafted clause against live submission and bind scenarios.
Raise clauses that are ambiguous or unworkable at the desk.
Done when every drafted clause is confirmed workable or amended.
verify: Re-test amended clauses against the same scenarios.
Pass when no published clause is ambiguous in the tested scenarios.

steps.title: Obtain approval from the documented approval authority
sop: Submit the drafted changes to the approval authority for the guideline document.
Record the approver name and the approval date.
Done when every change carries a recorded approval.
verify: Check the front sheet for the approval entries.
Pass when no guideline change is published without a recorded approval.

steps.title: Publish the new version and withdraw the superseded one
sop: Publish the new guideline version to the guidance library.
Withdraw the superseded version so it cannot be opened.
Done when only the new version is available in the library.
verify: Search the guidance library for the prior version.
Pass when only the current approved version remains published.

steps.title: Issue the change notification to underwriters
sop: Issue the change notification stating the clauses changed and the effective date.
Confirm the distribution covers every affected underwriter.
Done when the notification is issued to all affected underwriters.
verify: Compare the distribution list to the affected underwriter roster.
Pass when no affected underwriter is missing from the distribution.

steps.title: Update referral trigger configuration in the workstation
sop: Update the referral trigger configuration to match the new guideline.
Test a triggering risk in the underwriting workstation.
Done when the configuration matches the approved guideline version.
verify: Run the test risk through the workstation referral logic.
Pass when configured triggers match the current approved guideline.
